title: Praktikum Social Media & Content Creation (m/w/d) – Home & Living Brand MIAMIO
description: Du liebst Social Media, stehst gerne vor der Kamera und hast ein Gespür für Ästhetik und kreative Inhalte? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir sind Sayano , ein wachsendes E-Commerce-Unternehmen mit drei eigenen Marken. Unsere Marke MIAMIO steht für stilvolles Geschirr, modernes Design und hochwertige Produkte rund um den gedeckten Tisch. Als eines der von der Financial Times ausgezeichneten wachstumsstarken Unternehmen Europas verkaufen wir unsere Produkte mittlerweile in über 80 Ländern. Für MIAMIO suchen wir ab Anfang Februar 2027 eine kreative, kommunikative Persönlichkeit für ein sechsmonatiges Pflichtpraktikum, die Lust hat, unseren Social-Media-Auftritt aktiv voranzubringen. Bei uns übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung, bringst eigene Ideen ein und setzt sie selbstständig um. Deine Aufgaben Content Creation: Entwicklung und eigenständige Umsetzung kreativer Reels, Stories und Posts – von der Idee über den Dreh bis zur Bearbeitung. Vor der Kamera: Du präsentierst unsere Produkte in Reels und Stories und gibst MIAMIO auf Social Media ein Gesicht. Social Media Management: Planung und Betreuung unseres Instagram-Kanals mit dem Ziel, Reichweite, Engagement und Community weiterzuentwickeln. Influencer & UGC Creator Management: Recherche, proaktive Ansprache und Betreuung passender Creator sowie Koordination von Kooperationen und Content-Projekten. Trends & kreative Konzepte: Aktuelle Trends erkennen und daraus eigene Content-Ideen und Formate für MIAMIO entwickeln. Community Management: Austausch mit unserer Community und Betreuung von Nachrichten und Kommentaren. Kampagnen & Aktionen: Kreative Mitgestaltung und Umsetzung von Produktlaunches, Gewinnspielen und saisonalen Kampagnen. Das bringst du mit Studium: Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in im Bereich Marketing, Medien, Kommunikation, Social Media, BWL oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang und suchst ein sechsmonatiges Pflichtpraktikum in Vollzeit. Content Creation: Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Reels, Videos und Social-Media-Inhalten und weißt, wie du Content ansprechend inszenierst. Kameraaffinität: Du fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl, trittst selbstbewusst auf und hast Spaß daran, Menschen mit deiner Persönlichkeit zu begeistern. Ästhetisches Gespür: Du begeisterst dich für Interior, Design und Lifestyle und hast ein gutes Auge für Bildkompositionen, Farben und visuelle Trends. Design- & Editing-Tools: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Tools wie CapCut, Canva oder Adobe Photoshop und bringst idealerweise auch Kenntnisse in Figma mit. KI-Affinität: Du bist offen für den Einsatz von KI-Tools und hast Interesse daran, KI-gestützte Prozesse und kreative Anwendungen, beispielsweise in der Content-Erstellung, aktiv zu nutzen und weiterzuentwickeln. Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist offen, kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne proaktiv auf Menschen zu. Eigeninitiative & Ergebnisorientierung: Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, setzt sie selbstständig um und hast den Ehrgeiz, damit messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Organisation: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick. Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und fühlst dich in einem internationalen Team wohl. Das erwartet dich bei uns Hohe Eigenverantwortung & kreative Freiheit: Du gestaltest unseren Social-Media-Auftritt aktiv mit, setzt eigene Ideen um und erhältst regelmäßiges Feedback und fachliche Unterstützung durch deinen Teamlead. Kurze Entscheidungswege: Wir sind ein entscheidungsfreudiges Team, das gerne Neues ausprobiert und Ideen schnell in die Tat umsetzt. Ambitioniertes & ergebnisorientiertes Team: Wir setzen uns klare Ziele, übernehmen Verantwortung und arbeiten gemeinsam daran, messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Steile Lernkurve: Du sammelst wertvolle Praxiserfahrung in Social Media, Content Creation, Influencer Marketing und E-Commerce. Modernes, digitales Arbeitsumfeld: Wir arbeiten mit aktuellen Technologien, modernen Tools und KI-gestützten Prozessen. Zentrale Lage in Stuttgart: Unser Büro liegt mitten in der Stadt und bietet moderne Arbeitsplätze, höhenverstellbare Tische, Tischkicker, Spielekonsole, Küche und kostenlose Getränke. Regelmäßige Team-Events: Gemeinsame Aktivitäten und ein offenes, freundschaftliches Miteinander gehören bei uns dazu. Faire Vergütung: Dein Einsatz wird bei uns wertgeschätzt und fair vergütet. Klingt nach dir? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams! Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit: Deinem Lebenslauf Einem kurzen Anschreiben, in dem du uns mehr über dich und deine Motivation erzählst Relevanten Zeugnissen und deinem aktuellen Notenspiegel Einem Portfolio mit Beispielen deiner bisherigen Content-Arbeiten (z. B. Reels, Videos, Fotos oder Social-Media-Projekte) Optional: Links zu eigenen Social-Media-Profilen oder bereits betreuten Accounts Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! title: Technical Account Manager - Data.One
description: <p><strong>Technical Account Manager - Data.One</strong></p> <p>This Technical Account Manager (TAM) role is part of the DataOne business within the ClearScore Group. The TAM demonstrates a balance of deep technical understanding and ability along with outstanding customer service and account management skills. This individual would have responsibility over the full partner lifecycle from onboarding, launch and ongoing maintenance.</p> <p>The TAM role will work closely with the rest of the DataOne business which includes Product, Engineers, Analytics and Commercial counterparts in order to deliver the best experience to our partners.</p> <p>The TAM’s main focusses will be setting up new Partners to start using DataOne open banking data, being on hand to assist partners with changes, and help drive the performance of their open banking usage.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you will be doing:</strong></p> <p><strong>Relationship Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>The main point of contact for our partner relationships after contracts are signed; working closely with our Commercial team to understand needs and goals of Partners.</li> <li>Understand the Partners business objective and be able to be proactive in our approach to establish and maintain excellent partner relationships.</li> <li>Attend and support our Commercial team in partner calls</li> <li>Assist in researching trends and insights around delivering best in class partner relationships.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Integration SME</strong></p> <ul> <li>Onboard partners through the integration process, you will be the SME for each individual integration that they own and represent the voice of partners.</li> <li>Ensure that partners stay within the defined strategy of the DataOne team. When a partner is identified for bespoke integration, work with Product Management, Engineering, Commercial, and other identified teams to work through solutions for implementing the bespoke work.</li> <li>Take a data-driven approach to provide key partner insights about the integrations, and use these insights to improve our integration experience.</li> <li>Coordinate and manage Partner onboarding plans with our Commercial and Engineering teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Performance Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage all partner requests related to their usage of DataOne’s open banking services. Not only will you manage and process these changes, but you’ll also recommend improvements to ensure high Partner performance.</li> <li>Develop a working knowledge of the ClearScore marketplace landscape and share that knowledge with the wider DataOne team</li> <li>Create custom reports for Partners as and when requested.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Delivery Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Liaise with DataOne engineers to manage backlog of requests.</li> <li>Develop and document processes and procedures to drive efficiencies</li> <li>Collaborate with the DataOne teams to improve functionality to drive down BAU work and drive productivity of our Engineering teams.</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a background in Technical Product Ownership, Engineering, or another technical role with direct relationships with clients or partners.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills we'd love you to have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A natural planner - ability to coordinate and lead internal and external teams to deliver strong integration performance</li> <li>Highly analytical and data driven - excited by and proficient at using data to make informed decisons</li> <li>Confident working alongside and influencing senior stakeholders</li> <li>Strong writing, communication and presentation skills</li> <li>Organised, proactive, and great attention to detail</li> <li>Positive attitude, able to work under pressure and within a moving framework</li> </ul> <p></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Why ClearScore?</strong></p> <p>ClearScore is the UK's #1 credit score and report app. We are also present in South Africa, Australia and Canada, with more than 20 million users globally and growing fast. Someone joins ClearScore every 20 seconds.</p> <p>We have established relationships with over 50 of the main lenders in the U.K., and have been a trusted tool for customers to manage their credit and make better financial decisions.</p> <p>Since October 2016 we have helped 1.8 million users take out a new credit card or loan. We are user-centric at our core and we believe in leveraging technology to enable positive financial choices. We are design-led and data-driven and we embed these behaviours in everything we do.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">What is D·One?</strong></p> <p>D·One was created in 2022 as a result of ClearScore’s acquisition of Money Dashboard - a company with best in class open banking and categorisation capabilities. The D·One mission exists to provide open banking data to lending partners, market researchers including hedge funds and ClearScore. Currently, our primary goal is enabling lenders to adopt open banking by delivering a lender specific open banking service with best-in-class credit analytics.</p> <p>As part of the ClearScore Group, you will join a company where our culture is a fundamental part of all we have achieved. We believe in hiring smart, driven, passionate and diverse people who are keen on having a real impact in our organisation. We trust you to manage your own time so we offer flexible work and no fixed desk hours. We don't micromanage and we believe in measuring outcomes rather than effort. We have an inclusive culture where all, regardless of seniority, are encouraged to contribute with their ideas, look after their wellbeing and actively seek opportunities for career growth.</p> <p>If you feel like this could be the place for you, apply and our Talent team will be happy to share more.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p> <ul> <li>25 paid holidays and a “duvet day” on your birthday</li> <li>Hybrid Work Environment</li> <li>Private health and dental cover - including mental health support through Bupa&nbsp;</li> <li>GP office visits</li> <li>Life assurance scheme</li> <li>Up to 6% matched pension</li> <li>Regular Lunch and Learns with guest speakers</li> <li>Dog-friendly office</li> <li>Daily breakfast and free snacks</li> <li>Access to discounts via Cobens Extras&nbsp;</li> <li>Free sports and social clubs</li> <li>Continued investment into learning and development&nbsp;</li> <li>Leadership-led training</li> <li>In-house psychotherapist</li> <li>Financial coach to help you plan and achieve your goals</li> <li>No clock-watching culture</li> <li>Generous maternity and paternity plans</li> <li>Culture and inclusion representatives</li> <li>Transparent pay structure and a career growth plan</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunities</strong></p> <p>ClearScore is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. As an equal opportunity employer, we are able to make reasonable adjustments to accommodate individuals with disabilities during the recruitment and selection process. If you require accommodation, please inform us in advance, and we will work with you to meet your needs.</p> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><strong>Our Hybrid Model</strong></div> <div class="p-rich_text_section">&nbsp;</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section">We embrace a&nbsp;dynamic hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with collaborative in-person experiences. Our approach is designed to foster innovation, team connection, and individual productivity.</div> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Levels 1-5: Minimum 2 days per week in-office</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Level 6 and above: Minimum 3 days per week in-office</li> </ul> <div class="p-rich_text_section">We believe this structure offers the best of both worlds - the flexibility of remote work and the synergy of face-to-face collaboration. Our office days are carefully coordinated to maximise team interactions and learning/ mentorship opportunities.</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><br><strong>What This Means for You:</strong></div> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet p-rich_text_list--nested" data-stringify-type="unordered-list" data-list-tree="true" data-indent="0" data-border="0"> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Flexibility to manage your work and life</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Dedicated in-office days for team building and collaborative projects</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">&nbsp;Office facilities (with plants!) designed for productive interactions</li> <li data-stringify-indent="0" data-stringify-border="0">Clear expectations and support for maintaining our hybrid schedule</li> </ul> <div class="p-rich_text_section">We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment that accommodates diverse needs while maintaining our collaborative culture. Join us in shaping the future of work!</div> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><br><em data-stringify-type="italic">Note: While we offer flexibility, commitment to our hybrid schedule is an important aspect of our team culture and performance expectations.</em></div> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong data-redactor-tag="strong">Inclusion Policy</strong></p> <p>We are always looking for talented individuals to join ClearScore. We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for our people. Please see our People Policy Notice at&nbsp;<a href="https://www.clearscore.com/people-notice">https://www.clearscore.com/people-notice</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

The systems owned by the Consumer Payments team move billions of dollars per year, this means reliability and scalability are at the heart of everything we do.</p> <p>As part of the Open Banking team within Consumer Payments, you'll be working on building reliable, scalable and secure integrations with financial institutions and partners so that Affirm's customers can continue to get the best outcomes.</p> <h3><span style="color: #000000;"><strong>What you’ll do</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li style="color: #000000 !important;"><span style="color: #000000;">With the support of your team’s tech lead and manager, you will break down larger projects into individual tasks, deliver them in multiple phases, and collaborate with others to ensure timely delivery of your work.</span></li> <li style="color: #000000 !important;"><span style="color: #000000;">You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design &amp; analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.</span></li> <li style="color: #000000 !important;"><span style="color: #000000;">You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” &amp; on-call efforts.</span></li> <li style="color: #000000 !important;"><span style="color: #000000;">You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process.</span></li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: #000000;"><strong>What we look for</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li style="color: #000000 !important;"><span style="color: #000000;">You have experience shipping web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React or Vue.</span></li> <li style="color: #000000 !important;"><span style="color: #000000;">You have experience designing, developing and launching APIs at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.</span></li> <li style="color: #000000 !important;"><span style="color: #000000;">You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.</span></li> <li style="color: #000000 !important;"><span style="color: #000000;">You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.</span></li> <li style="color: #000000 !important;"><span style="color: #000000;">Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.</span></li> <li style="color: #000000 !important;"><span style="color: #000000;">You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Base Pay Grade - L</span></p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Equity Grade - 4</span></p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. description: Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were. We own onboarding and identity (KYC end-to-end), engagement systems (rewards, CRM tooling, Lemfi cash), and the internal SDKs and architectural standards that let other squads move fast without reinventing the wheel. If it touches how a customer gets onto the platform or how teams build reliably on top of it, it runs through us. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who is at home in Go, cares deeply about building things that last, and has the ownership instinct to drive a system from design to production with minimal hand-holding. You will be a key technical voice in the tribe - setting standards, shipping real product, and enabling the rest of engineering to move faster because of the work you do. Partner closely with platform and infrastructure teams to raise the reliability and observability bar across Foundations-owned services. Tackle the hard, ambiguous problems - new country launches, regulatory identity requirements, scaling events - and turn them into clean, well-documented solutions. Contribute to a high-ownership engineering culture: code reviews, architectural reviews, incident response and mentoring are part of the job, not extras. Your experience At least five years of backend engineering experience with Go as your primary language in a production environment. A track record of building and scaling distributed systems - you have seen things break at scale and know how to design so they do not. Experience working on or closely with platform or enablement teams: shared libraries, internal tooling, developer experience or API gateways. title: Senior Product Security Engineer
description: About Artificial Help shape the future of specialty insurance At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making. We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth. You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry. In February, we raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally. Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations. About the role We're looking for a Senior Product Security Engineer to make our applications, and the platform they run on, secure. This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll work inside our engineering teams, review how our platforms are designed, find where they are weak, and help get them fixed. Much of the job is setting up practices we don't yet have. You'll make threat modelling a normal part of how we plan and build, introduce vulnerability management across our applications and AWS infrastructure, and automate security testing at every stage of the delivery pipeline. We want checks that run on every change, so engineers find problems early and fix them in their own teams without everything having to route through you. We're investing in AI-assisted engineering across the company, and we have a working group exploring where it helps us build better software. Security is part of that work from the start. You'll join the working group, set the guardrails and automated checks that hold every change to the same standard however it was written, and use the same tools in your own work. Job responsibilities Make threat modelling a standard part of how engineering plans and builds, run it on the highest-risk work, and train teams to do their own Review the security architecture of our platforms end to end, and turn what you find into prioritised work Set up and run vulnerability management across application code and AWS infrastructure, with a clear severity model and agreed fix times Build automated security testing into every stage of the pipeline, covering secrets scanning, static and dynamic testing and dependency checks, tuned so it catches real problems without getting in the way Run internal penetration testing as a continuing activity, using AI tools to test features as they ship, and coordinate external testing Put AWS security guardrails in place as Terraform, and keep configuration from drifting Set up how we manage and rotate secrets, and build controls for our software supply chain Test that customer data stays properly separated between tenants, and raw.title: Senior Product Security Engineer
raw.description:
About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

In February, we raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Product Security Engineer to make our applications, and the platform they run on, secure. This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll work inside our engineering teams, review how our platforms are designed, find where they are weak, and help get them fixed.

Much of the job is setting up practices we don't yet have. You'll make threat modelling a normal part of how we plan and build, introduce vulnerability management across our applications and AWS infrastructure, and automate security testing at every stage of the delivery pipeline. We want checks that run on every change, so engineers find problems early and fix them in their own teams without everything having to route through you.

We're investing in AI-assisted engineering across the company, and we have a working group exploring where it helps us build better software. Security is part of that work from the start. You'll join the working group, set the guardrails and automated checks that hold every change to the same standard however it was written, and use the same tools in your own work.

Job responsibilities

  • Make threat modelling a standard part of how engineering plans and builds, run it on the highest-risk work, and train teams to do their own

  • Review the security architecture of our platforms end to end, and turn what you find into prioritised work

  • Set up and run vulnerability management across application code and AWS infrastructure, with a clear severity model and agreed fix times

  • Build automated security testing into every stage of the pipeline, covering secrets scanning, static and dynamic testing and dependency checks, tuned so it catches real problems without getting in the way

  • Run internal penetration testing as a continuing activity, using AI tools to test features as they ship, and coordinate external testing

  • Put AWS security guardrails in place as Terraform, and keep configuration from drifting

  • Set up how we manage and rotate secrets, and build controls for our software supply chain

  • Test that customer data stays properly separated between tenants, and keep production data out of non-production

  • Build the guardrails for agentic engineering, covering what agents can access, how they are sandboxed, which tools and connectors they can use, and the checks agent-written code has to pass before it merges

  • Give engineers practical security advice day to day, and fix issues yourself when that is the fastest way to get them fixed

About you

Skills, experience and qualifications

  • Strong product or application security background built on software engineering experience, and comfortable reading, writing and reviewing code

  • Experience running threat modelling and getting engineering teams to adopt it as their own

  • Experience introducing vulnerability management that engineering teams work to

  • Hands-on with security testing across the pipeline, including secrets scanning, SAST, DAST and SCA, and with tuning those tools to cut noise

  • Experience penetration testing web applications and APIs

  • Good working knowledge of AWS security, including access and identity, networking and encryption, and able to read, review and write Terraform

  • Use AI coding agents in your daily work, and can show security tooling, tests or review checks you've built with them

  • Understand the security risks that agents bring, including prompt injection, over-broad permissions and untrusted dependencies

  • A developer-first outlook, where success looks like engineers choosing the secure option and owning their own security

  • Clear communicator who can turn security risk into practical decisions for technical and non-technical colleagues

We especially want to hear from you if you have:

  • Built security guardrails for teams working with coding agents or automated software delivery

  • Worked on software that serves many customers from shared infrastructure, and the data-separation questions that come with it

  • Worked in a functional language such as Haskell, or built security checks for a language the standard tools cover poorly

  • Worked in InsurTech, FinTech or another regulated industry

  • Helped build security practices from an early stage

  • Spent time training and coaching engineers on security

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance

  • Income protection insurance

  • Life insurance of 4 * base salary

  • On-site gym and shower facilities

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Team social events and company parties

  • Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees

  • Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform

  • Company stock options managed through Ledgy

  • Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy

  • Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays

  • Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook

  • Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams

  • YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines

  • For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action

  • The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us!

    We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.

    Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.

    As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications.

description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals . About the Role: This role reports to the Director of Maintenance and Reliability. The Senior Maintenance Manager leads the maintenance and reliability function for our London compounding pharmacy, providing high-level support to Pharmacy Operations and Engineering through predictive and preventive maintenance programmes for all production, utility, and facility equipment. This position analyses, troubleshoots, and communicates maintenance problems and concerns in the following areas: electrical, mechanical, plumbing, compressed air and process gases, HVAC, and clean utilities, as they relate to equipment and controlled environments in the pharmacy. The Senior Maintenance Manager works with general supervision and interacts regularly with the Director of Maintenance and Reliability to receive guidance and feedback. Many non-routine activities will require the Director’s advance approval. This position will be in Enfield. You Will: Lead a team of maintenance technicians, supervisors, and managers across a multi-shift, multi-discipline operation. Own the predictive and preventive maintenance programme for all GMP equipment, including automated compounding and filling equipment, isolators and cleanroom pharmaceutical safety cabinets (PSCs), laminar airflow (LAF) units, autoclaves and depyrogenation ovens, pharmaceutical fridges, freezers, and cold storage, balances, and associated controls. Maintain and reliably operate facility and clean utilities, including HVAC and cleanroom environmental systems, purified water, compressed air, nitrogen and other process gases, and chilled and hot water systems. Document maintenance, technical, and other data on predictive and preventive maintenance charts, as required. Diagnose and repair equipment and systems throughout the facility, including electrical, mechanical, plumbing, compressed air, PLC/controls, and HVAC repairs. Identify facility and equipment issues and develop an ongoing strategy to chart trends and take remedial action using a predictive maintenance approach. Communicate to management all issues that could result in safety risks, product quality impact, or loss to Hims & Hers or its colleagues. Work as directed in all areas of the facility to maintain health and safety standards, ensuring compliance with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, PUWER, LOLER, the Pressure Systems Safety Regulations, and COSHH. Perform and oversee calibration and testing procedures on equipment to ensure accurate operation and compliance with quality standards. Conduct regular checks and measurements to verify equipment performance, including temperature, pressure, differential pressure, airflow, and other relevant parameters. Maintain calibration records and documentation in compliance with GMP, MHRA, and GPhC requirements. Ensure that all equipment meets regulatory and quality standards and take corrective actions to address any non-compliance. Collaborate with Quality Assurance, the Responsible Pharmacist, Validation, and Regulatory Affairs to implement and maintain proper documentation, including equipment logs, maintenance records, change controls, deviations/CAPAs, and qualification and validation reports. Support equipment and facility qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), commissioning, cleanroom classification and requalification (BS EN ISO 14644), and environmental monitoring activities, and maintain the validated state of equipment through the change control process. Respond promptly to equipment breakdowns, emergencies, and production interruptions to minimise downtime and protect patient supply. Work closely with pharmacy and production personnel to coordinate repairs and planned maintenance and minimise disruption to the compounding schedule. Develop and manage the maintenance budget, spare parts strategy, and external contractor and vendor relationships. Identify opportunities for process optimisation, efficiency improvements, and cost savings related to equipment maintenance and operation. Participate in cross-functional teams to implement improvement projects and contribute to a continuous improvement culture within the organisation. Stay up to date with industry trends, technological advancements, and best practice related to pharmaceutical and compounding equipment maintenance. Make sure all assets, parts, and work orders are updated and tracked in the CMMS for all facility equipment. You Have: Right to work in the United Kingdom. Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in a related field, such as engineering. Ability to safely lift and carry items weighing up to 25 kg, either in conjunction with regular responsibilities or those assigned in other areas as directed. Proficiency with business computer systems and applications, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and project management tools. Ability to troubleshoot problems with machinery without supervision or direction. Ability to document predictive and preventive maintenance charts, technical data, and other data; interpret data and provide relevant input for process improvement. Ability to communicate effectively with others in spoken and written English. Ability to bend, stoop, reach overhead, and climb ladders; ability to climb stairs up to three flights and work at height using scissor or bucket lifts. Ability to work cooperatively and collaboratively with others. Capacity to receive and apply cross-functional training; willingness to assist other functions and work groups as needed so the department achieves or exceeds its business objectives. Ability to comprehend and adhere to all company policies and procedures, including those related to attendance and scheduling, honesty and integrity, confidentiality, safety, and conflicts of interest. 5+ years of experience in maintenance or engineering within the pharmaceutical industry, or a similar regulated industry (e.g., MHRA, CAA). Working knowledge of GMP requirements (MHRA Rules and Guidance for Pharmaceutical Manufacturers and Distributors, the “Orange Guide”; EU GMP Annex 1 where applicable) and experience maintaining equipment in a GMP environment. Demonstrated high-level ability to troubleshoot, maintain, and operate advanced technical equipment in a related industry. Demonstrated ability to teach and motivate in a highly technical and fast-paced environment. 10+ years of formal leadership experience with direct reports, both hourly and salaried. Knowledge of and experience with PLC systems. Knowledge of and experience with CMMS systems. Ability to present problems and solutions in a formal setting to mid- and senior-level management. Ability to delegate complex tasks and follow up on completion. Experience working with multiple facilities and other facility managers to implement systems and solutions to network-level problems. Ability to assess talent at both the salaried and hourly level to provide performance management and reward based on accomplishments and ability. Ability to evaluate personnel needs and adapt existing resources by structure and shift to enhance the business and support operations. Business acumen, emotional intelligence, and willingness to objectively assess issues (both operations and personnel) and provide solutions. Willingness to participate in an on-call rota and be available for emergency situations. Formal training or certification (e.g., NVQ/City & Guilds, HNC/HND, or equivalent) in at least one of the following areas: electrical, mechanical, plumbing, air compression, PLC systems, or HVAC trades. Preferred Qualifications: 10+ years of experience leading multi-discipline teams. 10+ years of maintenance experience in a pharmaceutical manufacturing or compounding facility (including MHRA-licensed “Specials” or GPhC-registered sterile and non-sterile compounding), or a similar GMP environment with the equipment referenced above. 10+ years of electrical knowledge and electronic principles. Chartered Engineer (CEng) status, or advanced degree or training in engineering, maintenance, or another related field. Advanced formal training in lean or Six Sigma. description: Hi, I’m Ellie, People Lead at hx. I joined hx in January 2025 as a Senior People Partner and have recently stepped into the People Lead role. Outside of work, I’m an F1 fan and dog mum, so I’m no stranger to fast-paced environments or the occasional pit stop for walkies. Our People team supports all things people at hx, from performance and engagement to the systems, insights and day-to-day operations that help our teams do their best work. We’re growing the team and looking for someone to own our People reporting and analytics, while helping keep the operational side of the function running smoothly. It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning data into meaningful insights, wants to make a real impact and is excited to help shape how the People team grows alongside the business. Interested? Read more about the role and life at hx below. About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the People team Our People team owns the systems and data that keep hx a high-performance, high-engagement place to work: performance and growth, people analytics, compensation and benefits, and HR compliance. We are building the reporting layer that lets the business make faster, better-evidenced decisions about its people rather than relying on instinct, and we work closely with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data with performance and engagement data so leaders see the full employee lifecycle instead of fragments of it. Inside People and Talent, AI has already changed how we screen, how we write up interviews and how we surface insight to leaders. There is far more to do. Plenty of what we do still runs on manual effort that could be designed out, and this role exists to go after that. We care much more about what you have built and put in front of real users than about the size of the team you have sat in, and impact here isn't tied to title or tenure. You will work directly with People Leaders, with real scope to shape how the team works as we grow. One thing worth being direct about: there is no finished playbook here. If you need a well-defined remit and clear instruction to do your best work, this will be frustrating. If you would rather find the problem yourself and build the fix, you will have a lot of room.. What you'll be doing Build the AI tooling that our People and Talent function runs on. Agents that answer the questions currently landing in our inbox, skills that draft the documents we write manually, workflows that pull our systems together. This is the core of the role rather than a project on the side. Build out the People reporting layer, including dashboards on retention, attrition and engagement, and get to the point where you can tell us what the numbers mean, not just what they are. Work with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data to People data, and make that view something leaders can interrogate themselves. raw.title: People Operations Associate (AI and Automation)
raw.description:
Hi, I’m Ellie, People Lead at hx.

I joined hx in January 2025 as a Senior People Partner and have recently stepped into the People Lead role. Outside of work, I’m an F1 fan and dog mum, so I’m no stranger to fast-paced environments or the occasional pit stop for walkies.

Our People team supports all things people at hx, from performance and engagement to the systems, insights and day-to-day operations that help our teams do their best work.

We’re growing the team and looking for someone to own our People reporting and analytics, while helping keep the operational side of the function running smoothly.

It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning data into meaningful insights, wants to make a real impact and is excited to help shape how the People team grows alongside the business.

Interested? Read more about the role and life at hx below.

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the People team

Our People team owns the systems and data that keep hx a high-performance, high-engagement place to work: performance and growth, people analytics, compensation and benefits, and HR compliance. We are building the reporting layer that lets the business make faster, better-evidenced decisions about its people rather than relying on instinct, and we work closely with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data with performance and engagement data so leaders see the full employee lifecycle instead of fragments of it.

Inside People and Talent, AI has already changed how we screen, how we write up interviews and how we surface insight to leaders. There is far more to do. Plenty of what we do still runs on manual effort that could be designed out, and this role exists to go after that. We care much more about what you have built and put in front of real users than about the size of the team you have sat in, and impact here isn't tied to title or tenure.

You will work directly with People Leaders, with real scope to shape how the team works as we grow. One thing worth being direct about: there is no finished playbook here. If you need a well-defined remit and clear instruction to do your best work, this will be frustrating. If you would rather find the problem yourself and build the fix, you will have a lot of room..

What you'll be doing

  • Build the AI tooling that our People and Talent function runs on. Agents that answer the questions currently landing in our inbox, skills that draft the documents we write manually, workflows that pull our systems together. This is the core of the role rather than a project on the side.

  • Build out the People reporting layer, including dashboards on retention, attrition and engagement, and get to the point where you can tell us what the numbers mean, not just what they are.

  • Work with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data to People data, and make that view something leaders can interrogate themselves.

  • Learn our people processes properly, starting with onboarding, payroll data integrity and the performance cycle, then rebuild the parts that depend on manual effort.

  • Support our performance review cycles in Lattice and our engagement surveys, help analyse what comes out of them, and automate the parts that should not need a person.

  • Help keep our HRIS data accurate, including records, reporting and system troubleshooting.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped something with AI that other people used, whether that is an agent, a script, a tool, a bot or a side project.

  • Got past the first version. We will ask how you tested it, what it got wrong with real users and what you changed as a result. If you have a long list of things you have experimented with, we want to hear what each one taught you.

  • Worked with more than one model or platform, and formed a view on what each is good for.

  • Worked with a real dataset, cleaned it up, and drawn a conclusion you could defend.

  • Been responsible for keeping a system or record accurate, whether that is a tracker, a membership list, a codebase or admin for a part-time role.

  • Handled something that needed to stay confidential, or can show us how you think about handling sensitive information.

  • Genuine interest in how organisations work, and the willingness to learn a domain where the detail matters and the consequences of getting it wrong land on real colleagues.

How we build in an AI-forward company

hx is a maximally AI-forward company because we believe AI should amplify what exceptional people can achieve. Everyone here is a builder. That means staying close to what’s changing, continuing to learn, and using AI to raise the quality, pace and ambition of your work.

We expect everyone to actively experiment with AI and agentic systems, whether at work or in their personal lives. This means going beyond prompting, exploring what agents can do autonomously, and learning by doing. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to be curious, hands-on and willing to push what's possible.

Your current environment is context, not the answer. We’re interested in how you think about what should be possible now, not simply how things are done where you work today. We care about judgement, creativity and ownership, not simply using more tools.

The bar is simple: your work should be meaningfully better because of how you operate in this new world.

Compensation

This role sits within a £40,000 - £55,000 salary range. At hx, we're committed to salary transparency, you'll always have clarity on pay early in the process, and our Talent Partner will share more detail with you during initial conversations. We're also working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and games nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Initial call with our Talent team to kick things off and learn more about your background.

  2. Manager interview with our People Lead to explore your experience in more depth.

  3. Skills assessment, presenting a People Analytics deliverable to the team.

  4. Values interview to get to know how you work and how that aligns with hx's culture with our VP of People and Senior Director of Finance and Operations.

  5. Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Check out our blog at Insights & Blog - hyperexponential

We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

Our Cyber FDEs partner with the security and engineering teams that defend globally critical systems, from enterprise software to the core infrastructure it runs on. Cyber FDEs work closely with our Product, Research, and Go-to-Market teams to adapt our products and models to what customers need to defend their systems.

About the Role

You’ll build systems that give defenders an advantage at a scale few engineering teams encounter. You might help an enterprise identify, test, and deploy patches across hundreds of thousands of code repositories, or help a security team analyze petabytes of logs for signs of malicious agents or coordinated attacks. Across these deployments, you’ll build tools that customer engineers can trust to support consequential security decisions.

You’ll work directly with customer security teams, from CISOs to frontline analysts. As AI changes how attackers operate, you’ll help these teams determine where their defenses need to evolve, prioritize what to build, and validate solutions with the engineers who will operate them. Alongside OpenAI’s account teams, you’ll translate security priorities into deployed systems that help defenders cover more ground.

You’ll also help shape what OpenAI builds next. When you identify a gap between what defenders need and what today’s models or products can do, you’ll partner with Research and Product to define, build, and test capabilities that address it.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.

In this role you will:

  • Partner with customer security leaders and OpenAI’s Go-to-Market team to scope engagements, establish responsibilities, and define measurable success criteria.

  • Lead technical design and implementation alongside customer engineers. Integrate agents into security workflows, establish access boundaries, and determine which actions require human review.

  • Build evaluations grounded in the decisions defenders make. For a patching agent, test whether a fix blocks a known exploit while preserving expected application behavior. For a detection system, replay historical attacks alongside normal traffic to measure detection speed and false-positive rates.

  • Guide production rollout with the engineers who will operate the system. Provide the observability and controls they need to understand system behavior, intervene when necessary, and expand adoption with confidence.

  • Translate successful approaches across deployments into reusable tools and engineering practices that other defenders can adopt.

     

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including building and shipping production software.

  • Experience protecting production systems through work in security engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or product engineering.

  • Experience building and evaluating AI agents for software engineering workflows.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and practices that maintain code quality, reliability, and security.

  • Ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases and contribute maintainable, production-quality changes.

  • Ability to communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to engineering teams and senior security stakeholders.

Additional experience includes:

Cybersecurity spans many disciplines, and while we’re primarily looking for strong engineering generalists, we’d love to hear about deeper experience in any of the following areas:

  • Security curiosity and experimentation: You read CVE write-ups because you want to understand how things break. You may have built an agent honeypot to test a hypothesis—or prove a point—and enjoy turning a security question into a hands-on experiment.

  • Security community engagement: You enjoy exchanging ideas with defenders, whether that’s discussing security strategy with a CISO at Black Hat or comparing technical approaches with frontline practitioners.

  • Application security: You’ve written CodeQL queries or Semgrep rules, built fuzzing harnesses, or discovered and responsibly disclosed vulnerabilities.

  • Automated remediation: CI/CD is your happy place. You’ve built tooling that turns security findings into tested patches, dependency upgrades, or configuration changes across large codebases.

  • Detection engineering: You’ve written and deployed detections using Sigma, YARA, Splunk, or KQL and tested them against attacker behavior.

  • Cloud and identity security: You’ve designed cloud IAM architectures and investigated abuse of workload identities, role hierarchies, or cross-account trust.

  • Security research: You’ve reverse-engineered malware, developed exploit reproductions, or contributed to vulnerability research.

  • Agent security: You’ve tested agents for prompt injection, tool misuse, or credential exposure and built defenses against them.

Reporting to : Max Baldry-Steen, Director of Sales More info : The FAQ below, juro.com/careers , our handbook or ask ----- anything. HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER Juro has big ambitions: to make it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. And we'll need help doing it . Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity. Buyers come to Juro because we're easy to use and fast to implement, AI runs through the whole product and our product team ships fast. To keep up with that demand in 2027, we're growing our Account Executive team. Your role is to drive new business growth at Juro. That means: Meet or beat your ARR target (around $800k new business a year). Build a strong pipeline, with a good share of it from leads you generate yourself. Land a clear value narrative with prospects: real pain, a business case, buy-in from several stakeholders. Keep your CRM and forecast reliable and accurate. Run a high-velocity motion that makes it easy for smaller companies to buy Juro, alongside larger $100k+ deals. We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub . WHO WE LOOK FOR Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit. raw.description:
View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/ae

 

***

 

THE KEY BITS

 

  • Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK.

  • Flexibility: We have office hubs in London and Boston, plus remote teams across several European countries. Under our choice-first work approach, you can work fully remotely from Day 1. That said, we’ve found people generally ramp faster when they spend a few days a week in the office alongside the team (esp. in the early months) and we hope you’ll want to.

  • Salary: We benchmarked £62-70k base + 100% variable (OTE £124-140k) with accelerators, at IC3 level in our progression framework for someone based in the UK.

  • Interviews: 3 stages totalling around 3 hours over about 3 weeks.

  • Start date: As soon as you can start.

  • Reporting to: Max Baldry-Steen, Director of Sales

  • More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers, our handbook or ask ----- anything.

 
 

HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to make it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

Buyers come to Juro because we're easy to use and fast to implement, AI runs through the whole product and our product team ships fast. To keep up with that demand in 2027, we're growing our Account Executive team.

 

Your role is to drive new business growth at Juro. That means:

  1. Meet or beat your ARR target (around $800k new business a year).

  2. Build a strong pipeline, with a good share of it from leads you generate yourself.

  3. Land a clear value narrative with prospects: real pain, a business case, buy-in from several stakeholders.

  4. Keep your CRM and forecast reliable and accurate.

  5. Run a high-velocity motion that makes it easy for smaller companies to buy Juro, alongside larger $100k+ deals.

 

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

 
 

WHO WE LOOK FOR

 

Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

 

To succeed here:

Every Juror finds their balance across our four Principles. We hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

 

On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

  • You carried and hit a quota of around $800k a year at a B2B SaaS scale-up, incl. a good share of pipeline you built yourself.

  • You sold in a high-velocity motion - 5-week cycles and ACVs around $20-50k — you also closed some larger deals.

  • You multi-thread by default, and your discovery builds a business case with several stakeholders, not a feature tour.

  • You use AI every day in your sales work (research, call prep, follow-up) and have opinions about what works.

 

This job likely isn’t for you if:

  • Your quota, velocity or ACV are far from ours. Quotas under $600k, 90+ day cycles, or deals well outside $20-100k usually make ramping here hard.

  • You’re waiting for marketing to fill your pipeline. Our inbound is strong, but the best reps here build their own.

  • You rely on a single champion to carry the deal.

  • You wait for the buyer to set next steps. Here, AEs ask for the deal and drive it.

  • You don't want regular feedback. We share call scorecards and pipeline data openly, and we expect you to act on them quickly.

  • Your pitch is "sales-y". We sell to legal and operations leaders, who dislike that style.

 
 

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

The load on legal teams is increasing as business teams move faster with the help of AI. The only way out is to deploy AI within the legal team so that (a) routine contract work can be executed autonomously and (b) lawyers’ time is reserved for problem solving.

It’s like having an extra team member that is always on and takes on heavy lifting. Just like an in-house lawyer, Juro:

  • is present for, and trusted by, business teams

  • owns contracts from first draft to signature and beyond

  • builds judgement from every contract it works on

…all within guardrails controlled by the legal team.

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 60M users.

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better.

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead, working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles.

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

  • Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers

  • Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next

  • Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions

  • Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration

  • Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible

Your Qualifications

  • You’ve personally post-trained open-weight LLMs for a user-facing product and shipped them to production

  • You’ve worked where AI was core to the product or business, not an experimental side feature

  • Fine-tuning is core to your experience

  • Strong Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face, with hands-on GPU training and debugging

  • You build data and evals yourself and make decisions from evidence

  • You can take work beyond notebooks into production

  • You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work

  • You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content, including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system

Bonus points

  • Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI

  • Multilingual LLMs

  • Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing

  • Multimodal models

  • Open-source LLM / post-training contributions

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 60M users in 3 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 20 working days of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!


To learn how we collect and use your personal data during the recruitment process, please read our Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: Manager - Transaction Services
description: About Unity Advisory Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today's CFO, with connected solutions across finance, deals and tax. Focussed on client outcomes, seasoned experts lead every engagement, in an operating model powered by AI and free from audit conflict. Unity Advisory is a new kind of partner for the office of the CFO. Founded by senior leaders from the world's top advisory firms and backed by Warburg Pincus, we provide integrated finance, commercial, tax and deals support: expert advice, sharper execution, and delivery models built around how organisations operate today. CFOs need trusted advisers without legacy complexity, so we pair expert human judgement with proprietary AI workflows and smart automation, free from audit conflicts. The Role We built our deals practice around the client's decision: whether to buy, whether to sell, at what price, on what terms. We work alongside our clients rather than at arm's length, in the room while the deal decision is being made, and our support carries on beyond signing: into the 100-day plan, the hold period and the eventual exit. And that support draws on the whole firm: our tax, finance and commercial specialists work as one team with the deals practice, so the advice a client gets after signing is as integrated as the diligence that came before it. We're looking for a Manager to join our Financial Due Diligence team. You'll run buy-side and sell-side engagements day to day: getting into the numbers, managing the team on the ground, and making sure clients get clear, well-supported findings on time. You'll bring solid FDD or transaction services experience from a Big 4 or top-tier advisory firm, and own an engagement from scoping through to final findings. You'll work alongside our Partners and Directors and directly with clients and target company management from day one. This is a hybrid role based in our Mayfair office. What You'll Do • Manage buy-side and sell-side financial due diligence engagements from scoping through to completion. • Analyse quality of earnings, net working capital, cash flow and other issues that decide a deal, and turn the findings into a clear, well-supported story for the client. • Run the engagement team day to day: reviewing work, coaching junior staff, and keeping everyone (including the client) up to speed on progress. • Interview target company management and build working relationships with clients, private equity investors, and other advisors on the deal. • Draft and quality-check diligence deliverables so they're accurate, clear, and ready for Director or Partner sign-off. • Work alongside Unity's data and AI specialists to make our analytics standard practice on every engagement. • Take part in business development: proposals, pitches, and staying close to opportunities as they arise. What You'll Bring • 5+ years' experience in Financial Due Diligence or Transaction Services from a Big 4 or top-tier advisory firm. • Hands-on experience managing buy-side and sell-side FDD assignments from start to finish. • Strong technical grounding in accounting and the deal issues that matter most: quality of earnings, working capital, and cash flow. • A track record of being an excellent team player in multidisciplinary engagements. • Clear and confident communication (both written and verbal) with clients and senior stakeholders. • Curiosity and genuine interest in how technology and AI evolve financial due diligence practice and playing a key role in shaping it. • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent). Nice to Have • Experience with Private Equity clients or PE-backed portfolio companies. • Exposure to cross-border or international transactions. • Experience with data and analytics tools such as Power BI, Alteryx, or Databricks. • Sector experience in areas like TMT, Consumer, Healthcare, Business Services and Industrials. Additional Information We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments or support when applying or arranging your interview. We do not accept unsolicited CVs from third-party agencies.
