title: Chief People Officer
description: About Swap Swap is the infrastructure behind modern agentic commerce. The only AI-native platform connecting backend operations with a forward-thinking storefront experience. Built for brands that want to sell anything - anywhere, Swap centralises global operations, powers intelligent workflows, and unlocks margin-protecting decisions with real-time data and capability. Our products span cross-border, tax, returns, demand planning, and our next-generation agentic storefront, giving merchants full transparency and the ability to act with confidence. At Swap, we’re building a culture that values clarity, creativity, and shared ownership as we redefine how global commerce works. About the Role We are seeking an exceptional People leader to guide our global talent and organizational strategy through the next phase of growth and beyond. Swap is currently 350 FTEs spread across 9 countries, and has a number of critical hires in the near term. This is a crucial executive role for a People leader who is a proven talent magnet, a strategic operator, and heavily data-driven. The role demands global compliance expertise, systems thinking, a relentless focus on the employee experience and time-to-productivity, and a deep understanding of how to scale culture across borders without losing operational velocity. You will build and lead Swap's People function, shifting the organization from foundational HR to a strategic engine that drives tangible business outcomes and maximizes revenue per employee. This role is designed for a highly ambitious people leader who is excited about the opportunity to play a critical role in scaling Swap through to a potential future IPO. What You'll Do Leadership — Build and develop a world-class, high-performing People & Talent team, nurturing a team culture focused on business outcomes, operational excellence, and exceptional candidate and employee experience. Talent & performance — Build the systems that keep the talent bar high across the company, from hiring and onboarding through to performance management and manager effectiveness. Enable Swap's leaders to drive hiring in a hyper-growth environment, and ensure managers have the tools and support to lead their teams well. Culture — Strengthen and evolve Swap's culture as the company scales, ensuring Swap's values translate consistently regardless of the function, role or geography. Compensation & reward — Design and own a clear, competitive, and scalable compensation strategy that supports global hiring while remaining fair and defensible across markets. Org design & compliance — Own and execute Swap's global talent strategy, architecting an organisational design that supports rapid scaling across 8+ countries while mitigating geographical fragmentation. Navigate the complexity of EORs, local entities, and cross-border compliance, building cohesive global frameworks rather than one-off local fixes. Business impact & metrics — Ensure the People organisation is a core driver of business success, developing a clear people strategy and roadmap aligned to the business strategy. Define clear Swap People metrics and track progress against these such as Time to Hire, eNPS, and turnover. Own the People function's success measures and deliver results against targets set. Cross-functional alignment — Build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships across Swap's leadership team and beyond, aligning People strategy, headcount planning, and org design with the pace and needs of the business. What We're Looking For A builder at heart, energised by the opportunity to shape an emerging category at pace, and comfortable with the ambiguity of a fast-scaling startup. A proven track record of building and leading high-performing People leadership teams, with the credibility to attract and develop leaders of leaders. 12-15+ years of progressive People/HR leadership experience, with direct exposure to scaling hyper-growth tech organizations from 200 to 500+ employees globally. A mindset that balances people and business outcomes, using employee-centric thinking to build simple, scalable solutions to complex global compliance and talent challenges. Skilled at using modern HR tech, AI, and automation to drive efficiency and streamline all aspects of the talent lifecycle at scale. Experience leading teams across multiple international markets, dealing with complex cross-border employment laws and asynchronous work cultures. What we offer 💰 Competitive base salary: Pay that reflects your experience and the impact you’ll have, reviewed regularly as you grow with us. 📈 Stock options: Own a piece of what we’re building. As a high-growth scale-up, you’ll share in the upside as the company grows. 🏖️ Generous PTO: Competitive annual leave, with public holidays on top, plus your birthday off so you can celebrate properly. 🏥 Private healthcare: Comprehensive private medical cover, so you can get the care you need quickly. 🏦 Pension contributions: Company contributions to help you build long-term financial security. 🧘 Wellness benefits: Support for your physical health and wellbeing, so you can look after yourself in the way that works for you. 💚 Mental health support: Access to mental health resources and support, because looking after your mind matters as much as your body. 👶 Enhanced maternity and paternity leave: Extra support when you’re growing your family, so you can focus on what matters most. 🏡 Flexible working: Choose how and where you do your best work, with the trust and autonomy to manage your own time. ✈️ Work abroad for 4 weeks a year: Take your laptop somewhere new for up to four weeks each year, whether that’s family, travel, or a change of scenery. 🎉 Quarterly team offsite budget: A dedicated budget each quarter for your team to get together, connect, and have fun. 🍻 Thursday happy hour: Wind down the week with your colleagues at our Thursday happy hour, held across all of our locations. 🥞 Breakfast Mondays: Start the week with a good meal and good company. Diversity & Equal Opportunities: We embrace diversity and equality in a serious way. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills, and views. We’ve raised $110M from legendary technology investors, early backers of companies like Databricks, ElevenLabs and Vercel, and we’re growing at an extraordinary pace.

The role

Most engineers never get to redesign core infrastructure for the next 100x of scale. On Foundations, that's the job.

AI teams are generating video, images, 3D sensor data and documents faster than anyone's systems can keep up. Help us build the high-performance data systems behind the AI data platform for robotics and beyond.

You'll join Foundations, the backend backbone of Encord. We build the reliable, scalable, fast systems every other team and every customer runs on. The work sits deep in distributed and data-intensive systems: storage, indexing, querying and processing multimodal data at a scale few companies ever reach.

The timing is rare. A year ago we were a team of 100; now we're over 150 and still accelerating, driven by massive demand. We are building the team to unlock our next orders of magnitude of scale and capability.

What you'll do

  • Own significant projects in our data systems end to end: design, architecture, deployment, monitoring and measuring the impact you made

  • Build distributed systems that stay fast and correct under load, and reason carefully about every way they can fail

  • Shape performant protocols and APIs, that customers build directly on top of

  • Find simple solutions to complex domains at scale, and know when boring technology wins

  • Raise the bar for everyone around you through code reviews, pairing and sharing what you know

Why engineers join Foundations

  • Scale that's genuinely hard. Multimodal AI data is big, messy and growing fast. You'll solve problems most backend engineers only read about.

  • Real ownership. You'll own whole systems, not tickets, and the architectural calls are yours to make.

  • Work that ships. Your systems power 300+ AI teams, including Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath and Zipline.

  • Long-term thinking. A team that plans 24 months out and gives you room to build things properly.

  • The right moment. A Series C company growing fast, early enough that your decisions shape the platform for years.

Who we're looking for

  • You've seen and built a lot. You have personally developed and maintained multiple systems from scratch, and you know what trade-offs are involved in building reliable, performant software at speed

  • You combine rigorous engineering with ruthless prioritisation to ship efficient and correct systems quickly.

  • You're happy to tackle problems without a predefined, clear definition or obvious solution, and are excited to have autonomy to make decisions as you go

  • You understand that being a member of a high-performing team requires two things. You contribute your best work and help others contribute their best. You'll always lend a helping hand when needed and level up those around you

Experience requirements

  • Fluency in at least one high level (Python, Typescript), and one imperative statically typed (Rust, C++, Java, Go, or other)

  • Solid grounding in distributed systems concepts (databases, replication, partitioning, queuing, caching, consistency) and how they behave under load

  • Deep understanding of CS fundamentals, data structures and algorithms

  • Experience owning services in production and improving quality through code reviews, testing, rollout and monitoring

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Clear, accelerated growth opportunities as the company scales rapidly

  • Strong in-person culture: 4 days/week

  • Daily team lunches & dinners

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

  • US employees: 18 paid vacation days plus US public holidays

  • UK employees: 25 paid vacation days plus UK public holidays

  • Frequent travel opportunities across the U.S., London, and Europe

  • Bi-annual company offsites & monthly socials

 

Operating principles

 

High agency

You see something broken, you fix it or find the person who can. We celebrate the people who solve 90% of a problem before anyone asks.

Build with care & urgency

We bear-hug the customer. Former founders and people from fast-moving, high-stakes environments thrive here.

Self-aware & hungry

We stay warm, self-aware, and genuinely hungry. We elevate our peers, and ego doesn't last long.

Invent in real time

We move toward the ambiguity. We’re pragmatic, resourceful, energized by the fact that there's no playbook.

 

If you're looking to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who push you to be better, we'd love to meet you.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <p>Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.</p> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>Fanatics Markets is the real-money prediction and trading app where you can invest in moments you care about. Built on a secure platform, we let users predict real-world outcomes and trade on events they actually follow—from sports and entertainment to political elections and beyond. Our mission is to redefine how fans engage with the moments and markets that matter most. We're looking for the right people to help us build the future of prediction markets.</p> <p><strong>Role Overview</strong></p> <p>As a Staff Software Engineer within our Platform team, you will help define the technical direction of the platform underpinning our exchange and trading systems. You will lead the design and evolution of our infrastructure and platform standards to support a highly available, low-latency exchange, partnering closely with exchange engineers and engineering leads to enable rapid innovation without compromising stability or security.</p> <p>This role requires a balance of deep hands-on software engineering, systems thinking and technical leadership. You will lead complex projects that support the exchange—from load-testing environments and mock integrations to monitoring and automated recovery. You will turn ambiguous requirements into practical designs, own delivery from ideation to production and help operate the platform as the exchange goes live. The balance of coding and infrastructure work varies by project, but you should be comfortable independently developing new software as well as improving existing systems, setting platform standards and mentoring engineers across experience levels.</p> <p>On the engineering side, we are pioneering the use of AI as a code collaborator. We need engineers who have moved beyond experimentation—who actively use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to ship production code faster while maintaining exceptional quality.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead the design and development of software tools, services and automation that solve complex infrastructure, reliability and developer experience challenges.</li> <li>Define and evolve the architecture of highly available cloud-native infrastructure, balancing performance, reliability, security and cost as the platform grows.</li> <li>Set technical direction for CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling, remaining hands-on in delivering improvements to the software delivery lifecycle.</li> <li>Lead the development of load-testing environments and supporting software, including mock services and integrations.</li> <li>Establish and evolve standards for AI-augmented development, using effective prompting and validation practices to increase velocity without sacrificing code quality.</li> <li>Identify and mitigate AI-generated code pitfalls, such as security vulnerabilities or over-abstraction, and help teams evaluate the impact on quality and productivity.</li> <li>Guide the design and implementation of platform security safeguards and compliance standards to protect the integrity of the firm’s systems.</li> <li>Shape the system observability roadmap and lead improvements to monitoring, tracing, alerting and automated recovery.</li> <li>Partner with exchange, product and engineering leads to resolve architectural trade-offs, align priorities and deliver scalable platform solutions.</li> <li>Mentor engineers across experience levels, lead technical design discussions and raise engineering standards across teams.</li> <li>Participate in the on-call rotation, lead incident response for team-owned services and drive engineering improvements that prevent recurring incidents.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Skills</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Significant experience in software, backend or platform engineering, with a track record of leading complex technical projects and delivering production software and scalable, cloud-native environments.</li> <li>Deep software development expertise, including the ability to independently design, build, test and deploy services or substantial tools from scratch and guide others through complex implementation decisions.</li> <li>Deep hands-on Kubernetes experience, including designing and operating production environments, troubleshooting complex failures, and establishing patterns for high availability and efficient scaling.</li> <li>Strong hands-on experience with AWS and infrastructure as code using Terraform, including making architectural decisions across complex environments.</li> <li>High proficiency in Java and Python; Go is a plus. You should be comfortable bridging the gap between infrastructure and application logic.</li> <li>Deep understanding of distributed systems and the ability to make and explain trade-offs between low latency, high availability, scalability and operational complexity.</li> <li>Experience shaping CI/CD and observability approaches, with hands-on knowledge of tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or Datadog.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in using AI collaborators such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to ship production code and improve engineering workflows.</li> <li>Ability to evaluate AI-generated code for security gaps or architectural errors and establish rigorous testing and validation practices.</li> <li>Proven ability to turn ambiguous problems into a clear technical direction and deliver improvements across team boundaries, balancing immediate needs with long-term architectural health.</li> <li>Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions, influence without formal authority and collaborate effectively with distributed engineering and product teams.</li> <li>Experience mentoring senior engineers and building alignment around technical standards and architectural decisions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in high-growth startup environments.</li> <li>Experience with financial systems, exchanges, real-money transactions or regulatory compliance.</li> <li>Background in designing and building internal developer platforms, tools, CLI applications or infrastructure automation services.</li> <li>Experience developing load-testing environments, mock services or automated recovery systems.</li> <li>Experience leading technical initiatives spanning multiple teams or evolving platform architecture through significant growth or change.</li> </ul> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.</p> <p>Ready to build the future of sports betting? If you possess some of these skills but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply! Please note that <strong>visa sponsorship is not available</strong> for this position. We are open to <strong>fully remote candidates based in the United Kingdom.</strong> Remote employees may also be eligible for a home office setup stipend.</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p>#LI-AL1&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it&nbsp;</em><a ----- <p></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting &amp; Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.</p> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2 data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.organization-description-title'">About the Team</h2> <p>Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.</p> <h3><strong>Role Overview</strong></h3> <p>The Senior Campaign Operations Manager is a pivotal role responsible for taking operational delivery across CRM, Promotional Operations and Front-End Content &amp; Merchandising to a new standard, giving the business and senior leadership genuine confidence in what's being built, executed and delivered across every owned channel and touchpoint.</p> <p>You're hands on enough to troubleshoot live platforms and lead incident response the moment a campaign or promotion needs it, with an eagle-eyed view across everything live and everything coming next. You lead people the same way you lead delivery: coaching the team to raise their own standards, not just directing their work, and setting benchmarks the wider function can build on.</p> <p>Operating at the intersection of CRM, Operations and Product, this role is central to Fanatics' ambition to become the #1 Online US Casino by 2030.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <p><strong>Delivery Accountability &amp; Operational Control</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hold end-to-end accountability for the operational running of campaign, promotion and front end content delivery across the team, ensuring all requirements from Commercial, Analytics, Product and Engineering are in place from approved brief through build, QA, deployment, monitoring and post-launch review.&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain a complete, eagle-eyed view of delivery status, live risk and upcoming critical moments, keeping the campaign calendar, dependencies and escalation paths accurate.</li> <li>Hold the team accountable for quality and timeliness, stepping in directly when delivery or player experience is at risk, and surfacing systemic risk that needs action beyond a single workstream.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Incident Management &amp; Operational Resilience</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own on-call coverage and incident response for live campaigns, promotions and content, acting as the senior operational escalation point when delivery or execution risk surfaces.</li> <li>Troubleshoot platform and execution issues hands on, coordinating containment, stakeholder communications, recovery and post incident follow up.</li> <li>Own root-cause resolution, escalating platform-level causes to the CRM &amp; Promotions Enablement Lead where needed and driving corrective action on recurring or high-severity incidents.</li> <li>Establish the severity levels, playbooks and launch monitoring checklists that keep incident response consistent and repeatable.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Standards, Governance &amp; Compliance</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Set standards for campaign and content setup, audience selection, offer eligibility, testing, deployment and monitoring across owned channels.</li> <li>Own the operational QA and release readiness gate that live activity must clear before launch, in partnership with Commercial, Legal, Compliance and Product, ensuring responsible gaming, privacy and jurisdictional requirements are met with clear audit trails.</li> <li>Maintain the change controls, access permissions and documentation required for consistent, compliant and continuously improving execution.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Team Leadership &amp; Capability Building</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead, coach and develop the team, setting clear objectives, decision rights, performance expectations, and a benchmark for operational excellence that others are equipped to meet.</li> <li>Build capability and confidence across the function through hands-on coaching, playbooks and structured knowledge sharing, rather than direction alone.</li> <li>Create a culture of ownership and continuous improvement, where risks and mistakes are surfaced early and addressed constructively, and close capability or resourcing gaps as they emerge.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Cross-Functional Partnership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner with CRM Planning on the campaign roadmap, upcoming plans and capacity signals so operational readiness is built in early.</li> <li>Serve as the critical interface into Customer Support and VIP, briefing them on upcoming activity, equipping them to resolve player escalations, and feeding recurring friction points back into delivery standards.</li> <li>Represent operational readiness and delivery risk in cross functional planning for new campaigns, promotions, content and platform capabilities, connecting operational performance to player experience and business outcomes.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Skills &amp; Experience</strong></h3> <p><strong>Essential:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years in CRM, campaign or promotional operations, delivery management or lifecycle marketing, including proven experience leading and developing a team.</li> <li>Accountability for high-volume, time-sensitive operational delivery across multiple channels or workstreams in a complex digital consumer business.</li> <li>Hands-on working knowledge of CRM or promotional bonusing platforms (e.g. XtremePush, Braze, Optimove or similar) strong enough to troubleshoot live issues directly and assess technical risk.</li> <li>Proven experience leading incident response, on-call governance or escalation frameworks for live activity, with sound operational judgement under pressure.</li> <li>A track record of designing or improving operational processes, controls, service levels and performance reporting, drawing on workflow management tools (e.g., Airtable, Jira).&nbsp;</li> <li>Excellent 360° stakeholder management and people leadership, able to influence senior stakeholders across CRM, Product, Compliance, Commercial, Legal, Customer Support and VIP while raising team capability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in iGaming, sports betting or another regulated, compliance-heavy environment.</li> <li>Knowledge of online casino mechanics, bonusing platforms and player journeys.</li> <li>Working knowledge of SQL or BI tools for operational diagnosis, reporting and performance analysis.</li> <li>Experience operating in Agile or product-led delivery environments, and scaling operational governance or automation in a high-growth organization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Global Ways of Working &amp; Flexibility</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Canada or UK based, hybrid role operating within Fanatics' flexible working framework.</li> <li>Close partnership with both UK and US based teams, requiring effective collaboration across time zones.</li> <li>Occasional evening or weekend work during peak promotional periods and major campaign moments.</li> <li>Participation in a planned on-call rota is required, with on-call expectations and compensatory time managed in line with applicable local policy.</li> <li>Fanatics support a culture of trust and autonomy, enabling sustainable global collaboration.</li> </ul> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.</p> <p>For information about our benefits, please visit&nbsp;<a href="https://benefitsatfanatics.com/">https://benefitsatfanatics.com/</a></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it&nbsp;</em><a ----- <p></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div> <p><strong>Weekly office requirement:</strong> Monday/Wednesday weekly <br><strong>Employment type:</strong> Permanent<br><strong>Seniority level: </strong>Mid-senior</p> <p>At GWI we’re always looking for extraordinary people who thrive on making an extraordinary impact. Right now we’re looking for a<strong> Product Manager </strong>to play a key role in our <strong>User Management (Revenue&nbsp;</strong><strong>&amp; Enablement) </strong>team in <strong>London</strong>. If that’s you, and making a difference gets you out of bed in the morning, keep reading. It could be the start of something, well, extraordinary.</p> <br> <h1>Sounds great, what will I be doing? 🤔</h1> <p>As our Product Manager you'll own the systems that make GWI's subscription and consumption business run, such as billing, metering, user plans, feature access, product analytics and user messaging. It's the layer everything else sits on. Get it right and GWI can price, package and sell in new ways.</p> <br> <p>Two big pieces of work sit at the heart of this role. The first is billing for our consumption products, which is an area we're actively developing, and one you'll help shape. The second is making our internal tools talk to each other properly, so user data flows consistently between them and Salesforce, and everyone across the business is working from the same picture. Most of your stakeholders are internal - Revenue Operations, Finance, Business Intelligence, Client Success and Engineering - with some direct client contact along the way. You'll lead one squad of front-end and back-end engineers and a designer, alongside the PM and Engineers in our sister squad, Identity &amp; Access - together you cover the whole of User Management.</p> <br> <p>A few things you’ll be responsible for:&nbsp;</p> <br>👉 Connecting our internal user management tools with Salesforce and each other, so data flows consistently and user information is mapped the same way everywhere <p>👉 Billing for our consumption products - metering, API usage, payment flows and user plans</p> <p>👉 Customer feature flags, access and management - who can see what, and why</p> <p>👉 Product analytics - event firing, sign-up flow data, usage data - so the business can see what's happening and act on it</p> <p>👉 Building the roadmap from client feedback, internal stakeholder input and usage analytics, and prioritising the most valuable work</p> <p>👉 Scoping the work and owning how your squad delivers it<br><br>It’s also fun; shaking things up is what working for GWI is all about. You’ll need to be flexible, comfortable with continuous change, and working in a high-tempo environment.</p> <br> <h1>What do I need to bring with me? 🧳</h1> <p>You’ll need to be able to demonstrate the core skills this role requires. You don't have to tick all the boxes right away; the important thing is that you’re willing to learn. Here’s what the team will be looking for in you:</p> <br> <p>👉 You've shipped products at a B2B company</p> <p>👉 You've built complex roadmaps with cross-functional dependencies, and you can balance multiple priorities without losing the plot</p> <p>👉 You make informed decisions at pace, even when the picture isn't complete</p> <p>👉 You're a strong problem solver, negotiator and influencer — you get alignment without needing authority</p> <p>👉 You explain complex things clearly to very different audiences: execs, engineers, customers</p> <p>👉 You ask questions and draw knowledge out of your team to find the right engineering and design solutions</p> <p>👉 You make informed decisions at pace, even when the picture isn't complete, and you're happy taking a big initiative and running with it</p> <p>👉 Bonus points if you've worked with Salesforce before, or with tools that need to sync data between systems and internal user management systems.</p> <p><br>Equally important is attitude. We want people who think big (to make an impact), ask why (to find a better way), and show respect (to everyone, at every level, all the time). Those are our values, and they’re a big part of what we’re looking for in you.</p> <br> <h1>Why Join Us</h1> <p>👉 You'll work on how GWI packages its consumption products - commercial problems with real weight behind them</p> <p>👉 Your squad owns infrastructure the whole company depends on, so the work gets noticed</p> <p>👉 You'll build relationships across the business, from Finance to Engineering to the Exec team</p> <p>👉 You'll learn from a senior PM who knows this space, with room to run your own squad your way</p> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>Diversity, Equity &amp; Inclusion 🫶</h1> <p>Diversity is fundamental to who we are—as a data company and as a workplace. Our data reflects global realities, and so must our teams. We strive to build a workforce as diverse and inclusive as the insights we deliver.</p> <p>As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled candidates and are committed to making adjustments throughout the hiring process—whether that's extra time, materials in advance or a different format, breaks, an adjusted interview format, assistive tools, or flexible scheduling. We're happy to discuss whatever would work best for you.</p> <p>We actively encourage applications from underrepresented and marginalised communities.</p> <p>At GWI, you'll find a place to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and belong fully.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/2g0akAyAlUU?si=dIgYyrKaAlNZK-NQ" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>#li-hybrid<br>#LI-VS01</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Compliance Officer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.<br><br>SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.</p></div><h4><strong>PRINCIPAL COMPLIANCE OFFICER</strong></h4> <p>The UK financial crime program is being built now, and it has to stand up to the FCA. This role sits in Compliance, reports to the US BSA/AML Officer, and owns the UK framework end to end — AML/CTF, sanctions, fraud, ABC, KYC/CDD/EDD, transaction monitoring, SARs, and the operating rhythm. You will still work the hard cases. It is a builder seat with accountability, not a queue job with “strategy” in the title.</p> <p>If you have eight or more years inside an FCA-regulated bank, EMI, PI, or payments firm, have owned or rebuilt a financial crime control framework, and can still open a file, this is the seat. You will build the UK program from the ground up, setting the standards the team and the FCA will use. This is consumer-scale payments financial crime work – not a private-banking book – and you’ll sit directly with Product and Engineering. raw.description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator’s Summer 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading AI photo and video solution for e-commerce, helping businesses sell at first sight.

Backed by Series B funding, we’ve reached 300M+ downloads and now process around 7 billion images a year for businesses of every size, from solo sellers to global brands and marketplaces like Amazon, Decathlon, and Depop. We serve them through our mobile app, web platform, and API, with tailored solutions for enterprise catalogs.

We’re an international team of 130+, with offices in Paris and New York. We take ownership of what we build, move quickly to learn what works, and speak candidly, united by our ambition to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

 

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

  • French and USA payroll and entity obligations

  • European employees through an EOR setup

  • Growing Paris and New York offices

  • Multiple benefits providers and external partners

  • An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

 
 

What you will own

 

Payroll

  • Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

  • Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

 

Compliance

  • Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

  • Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

  • Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

  • Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

 

Contracts and People documentation

  • Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

  • Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

  • Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

 

Employee lifecycle

  • Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

  • Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

  • Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

  • Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

 

Benefits & Compensation

  • Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

  • Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

  • Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

 

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

  • HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

  • Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

  • Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

  • Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

 

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

 
 

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

  • Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

  • Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls

  • HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more

  • A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

  • Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

  • High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

  • Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

  • Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

 

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it.

 

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Vous maîtrisez les environnements conteneurisés (Docker, Kubernetes), l'Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), les pipelines CI/CD ainsi que les problématiques d'intégration et de développement d'API. Une expérience en MLOps, dans l'exploitation de solutions d'IA générative ou sur des plateformes Data modernes constitue un véritable atout. Une connaissance de Scaleway, OVHcloud ou d'environnements Cloud souverains sera également appréciée. Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes reconnu pour votre autonomie, votre rigueur et votre capacité à prendre en charge un environnement technique stratégique. Ce qui rend ce poste intéressant : -Une création de poste au cœur d'une transformation complète de la DSI. -Une plateforme Data & IA à industrialiser, avec de véritables enjeux de production. -Un environnement technique moderne et des projets autour de l'IA générative. -Un rôle transverse avec une forte autonomie et un impact direct sur les choix d'industrialisation. -L'opportunité de contribuer à la construction d'un SI moderne, évolutif et maîtrisé en interne. PROCESS : Après une première visio avec un membre de notre équipe, vous rencontrerez : - Un 1er entretien en visio avec RH et DSI - Un 2nd sur site avec la DSI Retour sous 48h à l'issue du processus. Envoyez-nous votre CV et si votre profil correspond, vous serez contacté par un membre de l'équipe dans les 24h. Comprenant 300 collaborateurs et des filiales dans de nombreux pays (France, Belgique, Suisse, Italie, République Tchèque, Emirats Arabes Unis, Brésil…), le groupe s’appuie sur sa capacité à fédérer l’excellence, via l’intégration d’expertises publicitaires leader de leur marché, de manière à concevoir et piloter des stratégies de communication 360 à l'échelle l’internationale.

En tant que Responsable Comptable Général, vous êtes garant(e) de l’ensemble des opérations comptables et financières. Vous supervisez la production des états financiers dans le respect des normes comptables en vigueur et assurez la qualité et la fiabilité des informations financières à destination des parties prenantes internes et externes.
 
Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec tous les services de la Finance (Comptabilité Clients, Comptabilité Fournisseurs, l’ADV et le contrôle de gestion), le service des ressources humaines et le service juridique et serez garant de la fluidité des échanges.
 
🗒️ Missions
 
1- Gestion quotidienne de la tenue de la comptabilité et le bon suivi des obligations comptables et fiscales : 
• Garantir la bonne tenue des écritures comptables dans le respect des normes françaises (et éventuellement internationales type IFRS si applicable).
• Echange continu et régulier avec la comptabilité fournisseurs et la comptabilité clients
• Assurer le bon suivi de l’établissement des déclarations fiscales (TVA, IS, CVAE, CFE, DAS2, etc.)
• Être le(la) référent(e) en matière de veille fiscale et garantir la conformité des pratiques aux obligations légales en vigueur.
 
2- Etablissement des clôtures périodiques (mensuelle, trimestrielle, annuelle) et Audit des comptes: 
• Etablir les clôtures complètes, analyse détaillée et formalisation des comptes et des
provisions
• Préparer les reportings périodiques financiers et comptables destinés à la Direction Financière et à la Direction Générale
• Etablir les états financiers et les annexes aux comptes annuels
• Assurer l’audit des comptes en étant le point de contact principal.
 
3- Management d’équipe : 
• Encadrer et animer une équipe comptable (recrutement, formation, montée en compétences des collaborateurs)
• Veiller à l'organisation et à la répartition des tâches au sein de l'équipe au quotidien et en période de clôture pour garantir le respect des deadlines
 
4- Projets transverses :
• Participer à la mise en place et/ou à l’amélioration des outils comptables et des processus internes
• Accompagner les projets de transformation liés à la digitalisation des fonctions financières
 
👉 Profil recherché
 
Formation et expérience :
• Issu(e) d’une formation supérieure en comptabilité, gestion ou finance (DSCG, Master CCA, École de Commerce ou équivalent)
• Expérience confirmée (5 à 8 ans minimum) en comptabilité générale, idéalement dans un environnement multi-sites/multi-sociétés ou en cabinet d'expertise comptable/audit avant un poste en entreprise
• Une expérience dans le secteur des médias ou une familiarité avec les spécificités liées au secteur serait un plus
 
Compétences techniques :
• Maîtrise des normes comptables françaises et idéalement IFRS
• Excellente connaissance des logiciels comptables et ERP (exemples : SAP, Sage, Oracle, etc.)
• Maîtrise avancée d’Excel
• Bonne compréhension des outils de dématérialisation et des processus de digitalisation comptable
• Bon niveau dans la pratique de l’anglais (écrit et oral)
 
Qualités personnelles :
• Rigoureux(se), Organisé(e), Structuré(e) et Polyvalent(e)
• Leader d’équipe ayant d’excellentes capacités managériales
• Sens de la communication et capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés
• Sensibilité aux délais et esprit de priorisation.
 
Informations pratiques
  • 📅 Contrat : CDI 
  • 💰 Rémunération : entre 55K et 65K en package (fixe + variable)
  • 📍 Lieu : Paris
🎁 Nos avantages: 
 
• Un groupe international présent dans le monde entier
• Des entités pluridisciplinaires expertes dans leur domaine : programmatique, influence, RP, 360, création de contenus… 
• Possibilité de mobilité interne au sein des différentes entités du groupe
• De la formation continue avec une Digital Academy 
• Un accès à la plateforme HappyPal qui vous donnera accès à des réductions sur de nombreuses marques et loisirs (cinémas, concerts, parcs d’attractions, musées…)
• Des cours de sports quotidiens dans nos locaux : pilates, cross training
• Un forfait mobilité durable qui vous permet de louer un vélo auprès de notre partenaire BeeToGreen ou de vous faire rembourser à hauteur de 45€/mois votre location de vélo
• Prime de cooptation

title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] – Data Intelligence Platform
description: About Actian Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale. Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI. We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term. The Opportunity We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation. This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company. You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation. You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards. We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work. This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position.   What You Will Own: 1. Platform Engineering & Architecture Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up. Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs. Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation. Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams. 2. Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments. Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production. Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies. Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments. Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required. 3. AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations Integrate AI agents into infrastructure operations, including incident triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting. Use AI coding assistants and development agents extensively in your own daily engineering work. Establish practical standards for AI-assisted engineering across the platform team. Identify opportunities to replace traditional tools and operational processes with AI-driven automation. Build the infrastructure required to support AI and ML workloads, including model-serving environments and associated data services. Ensure appropriate human oversight, security guardrails, and auditability for AI-driven operations. 4. raw.description:
About Actian

Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale.

Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI.

We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company.

You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation.

You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards.

We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work.

This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position.

 


What You Will Own:

1. Platform Engineering & Architecture

  • Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up.
  • Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
  • Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation.
  • Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams.

    • 2. Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment

  • Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments.
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production.
  • Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies.
  • Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments.
  • Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required.

    • 3. AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations

  • Integrate AI agents into infrastructure operations, including incident triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting.

  • Identify opportunities to replace traditional tools and operational processes with AI-driven automation.
  • Build the infrastructure required to support AI and ML workloads, including model-serving environments and associated data services.

    • 4. Security, Compliance & Reliability

  • Establish security and compliance practices supporting SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR.

  • Implement automated compliance evidence collection and audit readiness.
  • Establish observability, monitoring, incident management, and on-call practices.

  • Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Platform Engineering team.

  • Deep, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes.
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform or Terragrunt.

  • Strong AWS expertise and practical experience designing cloud-portable architectures.
  • Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience with self-hosted or on-premises enterprise software deployments.
  • Practical experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data residency requirements.
  • Experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps, and infrastructure efficiency.

    • AI-First Mindset

  • Extensive practical use of AI coding assistants, development agents, and AI-driven automation.

  • Ability to identify, implement, and govern AI-driven operational workflows.

title: Senior PMO Analyst
description: About the Role Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies. Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth. Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization. At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. What You'll Do Program Planning & Execution Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control. Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs. Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early. Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution. PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use. Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery. Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow. Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity. Risk, Issue & Performance Management Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges. Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time. Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership. Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention. AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking. Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate. Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs. Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making. Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned. Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders. Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration. Requirements What You'll Need Required Qualifications & Experience At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls. Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management. A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace. Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment. Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken. Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms. Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations. Eligibility to work in Switzerland. Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations. Strong Plus Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies. Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms. Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes. Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management. Nice to Have Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe. Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries. Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations. Who You Are You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results. You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle. You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture. You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans. You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations. You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward. You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation. You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables. You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company. You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues. You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs. What We Offer A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction. The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth. Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs. raw.title: Senior PMO Analyst
raw.description:
About the Role

Imagine this. You are joining Destinus at a pivotal moment, helping build a Project Management Office (PMO) from the ground up while supporting multiple fast-moving aerospace and defense programs. As a Senior PMO Analyst, you will play a key role in bringing structure, visibility, and execution discipline to complex programs, ensuring our Program Managers can focus on delivering groundbreaking technologies.

Destinus is scaling multiple aerospace and defense programs in parallel, and we are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who can take real workload off our Program Managers from day one. You will be embedded directly in our programs while helping establish the cross-functional processes, tools, and governance needed to support our growth.

Reporting to the Head of PMO and working in close collaboration with C-level leadership, you will have the opportunity to shape how our programs are planned, monitored, and delivered. From building integrated schedules and managing risks to introducing AI-powered tools and automations, your work will have a direct and visible impact across the organization.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

Program Planning & Execution

  • Proactively step in alongside Program Managers and take ownership of core PMO activities, including integrated program plans, milestones, critical paths, and schedule control.
  • Support one or several programs simultaneously, ensuring effective coordination and acting as a connector between teams and programs.
  • Track program dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple initiatives, identifying potential conflicts and escalating issues early.
  • Help Program Managers maintain clear visibility over progress, priorities, and delivery commitments, enabling them to focus on critical program execution.

PMO Development & Cross-Functional Processes

  • Work closely with the Head of PMO to build the PMO foundation from scratch, developing standards, templates, governance frameworks, and practical ways of working that teams actually use.
  • Lead the development and implementation of cross-functional processes spanning programs and departments, from Engineering and Supply Chain to Production, Quality, and Delivery.
  • Establish scalable processes that improve collaboration, consistency, and operational efficiency as Destinus continues to grow.
  • Help create a structured yet pragmatic PMO environment that supports fast decision-making without introducing unnecessary complexity.

Risk, Issue & Performance Management

  • Drive program risk and issue management by proactively identifying, assessing, tracking, and escalating potential challenges.
  • Coordinate and follow up on mitigation actions, ensuring risks and issues are addressed effectively and on time.
  • Prepare clear program reports, dashboards, and decision-making materials for program reviews and senior leadership.
  • Provide accurate and actionable insights into program performance, highlighting key milestones, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring management attention.

AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and apply AI-supported tools and automations to make PMO activities faster, more efficient, and more reliable.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive activities, including reporting, status consolidation, and action tracking.
  • Explore and implement practical solutions using AI tools, workflow automation, scripting, and low-code platforms where appropriate.
  • Continuously improve PMO tools, processes, and reporting methods to reduce administrative workload and increase visibility across programs.

Stakeholder Management & Leadership Collaboration

  • Work closely with Program Managers, the Head of PMO, and C-level leadership to support program execution and strategic decision-making.
  • Act as a central point of coordination across programs and functions, ensuring information, priorities, and dependencies remain aligned.
  • Translate complex program information into structured, concise, and actionable updates for different stakeholders.
  • Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, and other business functions to drive effective collaboration.

Requirements

What You'll Need

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in PMO, Program Management, or Project Controls.

  • Strong command of PMO fundamentals, including scheduling, risk management, reporting, and stakeholder management.

  • A proactive, structured, and pragmatic approach to work, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to operate at pace.

  • Confidence working from a blank page and building structure in a fast-moving, ambiguous scale-up environment.

  • Fluency in English and German, both written and spoken.

  • Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools such as MS Project, Jira, Microsoft Dynamics and other ERP systems, Smartsheet, Confluence, or similar platforms.

  • Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create clear reports, dashboards, and leadership presentations.

  • Eligibility to work in Switzerland.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to other Destinus locations.

Strong Plus

  • Previous consulting experience, ideally involving PMO setup, transformation, or hands-on PMO support for client companies.

  • Practical experience using AI tools and automation technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), workflow automation, scripting, or low-code platforms.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and improving cross-functional business processes.

  • Understanding of hardware development and engineering environments, including product lifecycle management, gate reviews, and change management.

Nice to Have

  • Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, or SAFe.

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or other complex hardware industries.

  • Technical skills in Python, SQL, Power BI, or API-based integrations.

Who You Are

  • You are proactive by nature and do not wait for instructions to make things happen. You identify what needs to be done, take ownership, and deliver results.

  • You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly, ambiguity is part of the challenge, and building structure from scratch is an opportunity rather than an obstacle.

  • You combine strong analytical thinking with a practical, hands-on approach, knowing when to dive into the details and when to focus on the bigger picture.

  • You enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, transforming scattered information, competing priorities, and challenging timelines into actionable plans.

  • You are comfortable working closely with Program Managers and senior leadership, communicating confidently and turning complex program information into clear recommendations.

  • You are naturally collaborative and know how to connect people, teams, and functions to keep programs moving forward.

  • You challenge inefficient processes and actively look for smarter ways of working, especially through technology, AI, and automation.

  • You are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing sight of deadlines or deliverables.

  • You bring a continuous improvement mindset, balancing the discipline of structured program management with the flexibility required in a rapidly growing company.

  • You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions, and working independently while knowing when to involve others or escalate critical issues.

  • You value transparency, accountability, and teamwork, and you are motivated by making a tangible impact on complex aerospace and defense programs.

What We Offer

  • A founding role in building the PMO of a fast-growing aerospace company, with the opportunity to shape its structure and future direction.

  • The freedom to develop and influence the tools, processes, standards, and ways of working that will support our continued growth.

  • Direct access to senior leadership, including close collaboration with the Head of PMO and C-level executives, and the opportunity to make a visible impact across multiple programs.

  • The chance to join a high-performing, international team working on advanced aerospace and defense technologies that matter.

title: Control & Estimation Intern
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on. These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation. Your mission The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions. Responsibilities Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment. Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines. Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware. Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions. Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment. Candidates Requirements Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus. Technical skills : Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus. Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.
