You own your project end to end, from literature review and scoping to implementation and benchmarking, on topics shaped by live projects and production needs. You work in a fast-paced engineering team with an industrial, production-first mindset, on cutting-edge research topics in an emerging defense company where the stakes are high. You are a full member of the team, with visibility on how the company and its products evolve and a direct impact on what we ship.

 
 

Responsibilities

  • Run literature reviews and state-of-the-art analyses on computer vision and machine learning topics framed by the team.

  • Scope projects, define tasks, and decide which approaches to benchmark, from baselines to the most prominent algorithms.

  • Build experimentation plans and define implementation architectures for novel approaches.

  • Collect, prepare, synthesize, and augment data for model training and evaluation.

  • Implement, train, and benchmark models across topics such as foundation models, knowledge distillation, CNNs, transformers, and embedded models.

  • Explore multi-sensor fusion and the processing of temporal data where projects call for it.

  • Evaluate results rigorously with task-specific metrics to judge relevance and feasibility.

  • Develop proofs of concept and support the transition of promising ones towards production.

  • Present concepts, results, and project status to the team and to wider audiences, and join team meetings to learn from other projects.

 
 

Candidate Requirements

  • Currently pursuing an MSc in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with ML projects involving model training and evaluation, ideally across different tasks and architectures such as CNNs and transformers.

  • Ability to select the best-performing model for a use case and to choose suitable task-specific evaluation metrics.

  • Familiarity with computer vision and image processing is a plus, such as classification, detection, tracking, segmentation, depth estimation, or 3D vision.

  • Awareness of model scale trade-offs, from large multi-GPU architectures to small optimized models on embedded platforms.

  • Motivated, autonomous, and proactive, with the ability to own a project and communicate results clearly.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Responsibilities</p> <ul> <li>Act as internal-facing and technical owner of the IT infrastructure and security landscape: network, firewalling and web filtering, Microsoft 365/Azure tenants, identity and access management, endpoints, backup, and secure remote/supplier access to BESS sites.</li> <li>Maintain the asset and configuration inventory, network and security architecture documentation, risk register, vulnerability backlog, security policies and the infrastructure/security roadmap.</li> <li>Run the risk management and vulnerability management cycle: periodic assessments, prioritisation, patching and remediation tracking across IT systems, applications, APIs and BESS connectivity.</li> <li>Define and operate security monitoring, incident response, escalation paths, maintenance windows and problem management, together with external service providers (MSP/MSSP).</li> <li>Define backup and retention policies (daily, monthly, yearly; 10+ years for critical data), offline/immutable backups, disaster-recovery runbooks and regular restore and DR tests.</li> <li>Define secure segmentation between corporate IT and the OT/BESS environment and secure remote access for O&amp;M and field service, aligned with IEC 62443 concepts.</li> <li>Provide infrastructure, system-integration and cybersecurity support to the After Sales &amp; Service framework once operational responsibility moves to the Service Manager.</li> <li>Support B2B customer and audit requests: security questionnaires, tender requirements and compliance evidence.</li> <li>Hands on when required: configure firewall rules, endpoint and identity policies, backup jobs and cloud security settings.</li> </ul> <p>Key Projects (2027 portfolio)</p> <ul> <li>Risk Management &amp; Recovery System (Feb–Apr 2027): offline backup and disaster recovery for critical systems such as BESS/EMS, ERP and CRM.</li> <li>Network Improvements (Feb–Jun 2027): introduce firewalling and web filtering, which are not yet in place.</li> <li>Advanced Threat Protection – ISO 27001 (Mar–May 2027): protect network and application traffic, including APIs and IP-based access.</li> <li>ISO 27001 Enhancements (ongoing): close control gaps, maintain policies and evidence, and prepare for audits.</li> <li>Take over operation of granular backup and advanced endpoint management, and provide security input to the PHENOGY IoT solution POC (BMS/EMS communication and REST APIs).</li> </ul> <p>Core Competencies</p> <ul> <li>Lead assigned infrastructure and cybersecurity projects from initiation through closure, using structured scope, schedule, budget, dependency, risk, issue, decision and change control.</li> <li>Create project charters, work breakdown structures, delivery plans, security requirements, test and DR-test plans, cutover plans, acceptance records and handover packages to operations.</li> <li>Coordinate external suppliers (MSP/MSSP, network and firewall vendors, cloud providers, BESS/EMS partners) to resolve cross-functional blockers and escalate material decisions to the Head of IT and relevant governance bodies.</li> <li>Provide concise status reporting on progress, milestones, risk posture, vulnerabilities, incidents, suppliers and compliance.</li> </ul> <p>Required Qualifications &amp; Experience</p> <ul> <li>Degree or equivalent professional experience in information technology, computer science, information security, engineering or a related discipline.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity management, including responsibility for delivering projects, ideally in an international mid-sized company.</li> <li>Practical experience with network security (firewalls, VPN, segmentation, web filtering, IDS/IPS), Microsoft 365 / Entra ID / Intune / Defender, and backup and disaster recovery.</li> <li>Experience running risk assessments, vulnerability management and security incident response.</li> <li>Hands-on experience implementing or maintaining an ISMS according to ISO/IEC 27001.</li> <li>Experience coordinating technical suppliers and multidisciplinary stakeholders across business, IT and engineering.</li> <li>Ability to understand operational technology and industrial-system boundaries without assuming ownership of safety engineering or embedded-control design.</li> <li>Strong documentation, risk management and executive-status reporting skills.</li> <li>Professional English; German or another relevant operating language is an advantage.</li> </ul> <p>Strongly preferred</p> <ul> <li>Experience securing Battery Energy Storage Systems, EMS, BMS, SCADA, PLC, PCS/inverters, industrial gateways, IoT or energy-data platforms.</li> <li>Working knowledge of IEC 62443, NIS2 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act in mixed IT/OT environments.</li> <li>Experience with Azure networking and security, Microsoft Sentinel / Defender XDR and enterprise firewall platforms (e.g. Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point).</li> <li>Familiarity with industrial protocols and secure integration patterns, including Modbus TCP, OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs, API gateways and certificate/PKI management.</li> <li>Experience with backup and DR solutions for cloud and hybrid environments, including immutable and offline backups.</li> <li>Recognized credentials such as CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, GICSP, PMP, PRINCE2 or ITIL are advantageous</li> </ul> <p>Decision-making authority: Approves infrastructure and security changes, firewall and access rules and security exceptions within the agreed policy framework and budget; raw.title: Technical Marketing Engineer
raw.description:
The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if

  • You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

  • You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

  • You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems.

  • You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message.

This role is probably not for you if

  • Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations.

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities.

  • Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

  • Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

description: <h3><strong>Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d)</strong></h3> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Maastricht, Aachen, and Eindhoven region, working mainly on-site with our development partner in Maastricht. Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month.</p> <p><strong>Reports to:</strong> CTO</p> <p><strong>About the venture: ROB'E</strong></p> <p>ROB'E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field.</p> <p>Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality &amp; Regulatory.</p> <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB'E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and own the mechatronic system architecture: robotic device, drives, force and torque sensing, real-time controllers, safety supervisor, power supply and the interface to commercial TEE probes.</li> <li>Translate user and system requirements into subsystem and interface specifications and keep them traceable through verification.</li> <li>Act as technical counterpart to our engineering development partner, from ideation, technology and part selection through design reviews and approval of design outputs. Challenge cost and effort and make the make-or-buy call per subsystem.</li> <li>Work closely with the System Software Architect on the hardware/software split, real-time control, and safety architecture.</li> <li>Drive the hardware contribution to risk management (ISO 14971), including design FMEA and risk control measures.</li> <li>Plan and lead hardware verification, pre-compliance and full compliance testing for electrical safety and EMC (IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2) with external test houses.</li> <li>Contribute hardware documentation to the design history file and technical raw.title: Credit and Financial Risk Manager
raw.description:
We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can. ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

 

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our Risk team as a Credit and Financial Risk Manager?

Reporting to the Chief Risk Officer, you will lead independent second-line oversight of ClearBank's lending and financial risk activities. As a senior risk leader and recognised subject-matter expert, you will translate Risk strategy into business-critical delivery, shape appetite, policy, controls and governance, and influence material decisions across ClearBank Europe and the wider Group. You will provide authoritative challenge, anticipate emerging issues, lead complex remediation and recovery activity, and strengthen organisational capability while enabling sustainable growth.

 

Your role includes:

  • Provide independent second-line oversight and challenge across the design, approval, launch and ongoing management of lending products, ensuring material risks are understood, controlled and aligned with approved appetite.

  • Own the second-line review and challenge of complex or material credit proposals, portfolio strategies and periodic reviews, providing clear recommendations to senior decision-makers and governance committees.

  • Set the second-line approach to non-performing and vulnerable exposures, leading complex recovery strategies, senior stakeholder engagement, escalation and resolution to minimise losses and protect ClearBank's interests.

  • Shape and maintain the policy, appetite, control and governance framework across the credit lifecycle, partnering with model validation and other specialists to ensure credit risk and provisioning models remain robust and fit for purpose.

  • Provide senior oversight of financial risks, including asset and liability, liquidity and interest-rate risk, connecting risk assessments across disciplines and anticipating emerging balance-sheet vulnerabilities.

  • Lead complex, cross-functional risk initiatives with potential enterprise application, translating strategy and regulatory expectations into practical improvements across ClearBank Europe and the wider ClearBank Group.

What does success in this role look like:

You will:

  • Maintain a high-quality lending portfolio that enables sustainable growth within risk appetite.

  • Deliver forward-looking credit and financial risk insight that improves senior and committee decisions.

  • Resolve complex and emerging risks issues, including non-performing exposures, through decisive intervention, recovery and escalation.

  • Shape scalable policies, appetite, controls and governance for growth and regulatory change.

  • Act as a recognised expert and trusted adviser, influencing senior stakeholders through expertise, sound judgement and constructive challenge.

  • Align functions on competing priorities, ownership and enterprise risk outcomes.

  • Build capability through coaching, delegation and knowledge sharing.

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Extensive experience leading second-line challenge of complex credit risk in regulated financial services.

  • A track record of launching and scaling credit products within robust risk governance.

  • Advanced expertise in institutional lending, portfolios, problem exposures and risk drivers.

  • Strong knowledge of liquidity, interest-rate and asset-and-liability risk.

  • Ability to lead complex work independently and improve risk outcomes.

  • Exceptional analytical and communication skills, with credibility among senior stakeholders and committees.

  • Leadership experience in coaching, setting standards and creating accountability.

 

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank.

  • You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care.

  • You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate.

  • ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary.

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

 

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you, combining working from our Amsterdam office with working from home.

  • Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus public holidays.

  • Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

  • Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the Netherlands for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

  • Socials – Regular social events open to all.

  • Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

  • Wellbeing – long term disability cover and accident cover.

  • Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

  • Pension – We offer generous pension contribution without mandatory employee contribution.

  • Expense coverage – Mobile phone allowance and travel cost reimbursement.

  • Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

  • Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

Role level: 5

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!

ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation.

title: Platform Engineer
description: Platform Engineer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Achter elke krachtige applicatie staat een stabiele en schaalbare cloudinfrastructuur. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Platform Engineer . Iemand die zelfstandig complete IT-omgevingen ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert. Je pakt complexe migraties van A tot Z op en bouwt met visie aan een ijzersterk platform. Jouw rol Als Platform Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van requirements tot oplevering. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. raw.title: macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer
raw.description:
We are looking for a hands-on macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer to engineer, automate and continuously improve the services that support our global Apple device estate. This role is focused on delivering a secure, reliable and consistent macOS experience at scale through Jamf Pro, reusable code, APIs and modern engineering practices. 
 
You will replace repetitive administration and one-off scripts with maintainable automation for device enrolment, configuration, application delivery, patching, compliance and lifecycle management. Working across Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager, identity, security, asset and service-management platforms, you will build integrations and workflows that make Apple device services easier to operate, measure and support. 
 

Engineering mindset 
Automation is the product, not an afterthought. We are looking for someone who sees a manual Jamf task, fragile policy or recurring Mac support issue and asks, “How can we make this reliable, reusable and self-service?” 

You should be comfortable working from Apple and Jamf documentation, investigating unfamiliar behaviours and translating operational requirements into production-quality automation. Your solutions account for failure, test changes before release, scale to an enterprise environment, provide useful telemetry and favour reusable frameworks over isolated scripts. You take ownership from design through operation, document your work and balance long-term platform improvements with immediate business needs. 
 
What success looks like 
You will measurably reduce manual effort, deployment lead time and configuration drift across the macOS estate. Enrollment, configuration, software delivery, patching, security compliance and device lifecycle processes will become increasingly automated, observable, auditable and recoverable. 
 
Over time, you will establish a scalable Apple endpoint automation model based on Jamf Pro, APIs, version-controlled code, release pipelines and shared engineering standards rather than manual platform administration. 


What you'll do

macOS Platform & Jamf Automation 

  • Design and maintain automation for macOS enrolment, provisioning, configuration, application delivery, updates and device retirement using Jamf Pro. 

  • Build reusable scripts, tools and workflows using shell scripting, Python, Jamf APIs and other appropriate technologies. 

  • Administer and automate Jamf policies, configuration profiles, Jamf Blueprints, Jamf compliance, extension attributes, smart groups, packages and lifecycle workflows. 

  • Integrate Jamf Pro and Apple Business Manager with identity, security, asset, infrastructure and service-management platforms. 

  • Apply Git, CI/CD, automated testing and configuration-as-code practices so Apple platform changes are controlled, repeatable and auditable. 

    • Security, Compliance & Observability 

  • Translate macOS security and compliance requirements into Jamf configuration profiles, automated controls and measurable outcomes. 

  • Automate macOS and third-party application patching, vulnerability remediation and exception handling. 

  • Build guardrails for FileVault, endpoint protection, authentication, privacy controls and device compliance. 

  • Create inventory, telemetry, dashboards and alerting that provide actionable visibility into automation performance, Mac health and risk. 

  • Partner with Security teams to automate evidence collection, audit reporting and remediation workflows for the Apple estate. 

    • Engineering, Lifecycle & Support 

  • Define the macOS and Jamf automation architecture, engineering standards and roadmap for a global Apple device service. 

  • Engineer automated packaging, deployment, update and rollback pipelines for macOS applications. 

  • Evaluate Jamf, Apple and related ecosystem capabilities, APIs and emerging technologies to simplify or extend the service. 

  • Troubleshoot complex failures across macOS, Jamf, identity, networking, security and application-delivery services. 

  • Convert recurring Mac incidents and support escalations into automated detection, remediation or prevention. 

  • Document designs, code, operating procedures and support models, and enable support teams to use them effectively. 

    •  
     

    What you'll need

  • Jamf 300 certification. 

  • 4+ years of experience engineering and automating macOS services in a modern enterprise environment. 

  • Deep hands-on expertise with Jamf Pro, including policies, profiles, smart groups, extension attributes, inventory, application deployment and API-based administration. 

  • Strong knowledge of macOS management, Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment, declarative device management and Apple security controls. 

  • Ability to build production-quality automation using shell scripting, Python, REST APIs and structured data formats, supported by Git, CI/CD, testing, secrets management, Jamf webhooks and code review. 

  • Experience automating macOS application packaging, deployment, patching and vulnerability remediation; a bachelor’s degree in IT or Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. 

    •

  • Experience with identity integrations, Platform SSO, certificate services, zero-touch deployment and device trust. 

  • Knowledge of Installomator, swiftDialog, Nudge, or similar community and enterprise macOS automation tooling. 

  • Experience integrating Jamf with ServiceNow, asset-management, security, observability or data platforms.

Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen. Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld: consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren; onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden; ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen; onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop; kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid; kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen; jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen. Aan het einde van je stage presenteer je jouw belangrijkste inzichten en aanbevelingen aan ons Sales & Marketing team. En als het binnen je stage past, kun je misschien zelfs één van je ideeën in de praktijk testen. De precieze inhoud stemmen we af op de duur van je stage en de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding. Goed om te weten; onze farm is nog volop in ontwikkeling, we zitten nog in onze start-up/scale-up fase. Dit betekent dat je naast je onderzoek ook tijd zult besteden aan andere zaken in onze farm. Dit geldt niet alleen voor jou als stagiair maar voor ons hele team. Zo draait iedereen uit kantoor maandelijks een shift in de farm, waarbij we helpen met zaaien, oogsten of verpakken. 🌱 Wat kun je van ons verwachten? Je volgt een HBO of WO opleiding in Nederland en staat daar ingeschreven gedurende de hele stage periode. title: Product Manager Insurance P&C
description: Insify is looking for a smart, ambitious and relentlessly driven Insurance Product Manager to join our team. In this role you’ll be a driving force behind our product expansions and building the digital platform for SME insurance. A rare opportunity to take real ownership in a fast-scaling European insurtech and shape outcomes that matter. At Insify, we build insurance for entrepreneurs because we are entrepreneurs ourselves. We know what it’s like to build something from scratch, to take risks, and to carry responsibility that doesn’t switch off at 5 pm. Our mission is simple but ambitious: to make business insurance 10x simpler, faster, and fairer for entrepreneurs and SMEs across Europe . No paperwork. No fine print. No legacy complexity. Just modern software, smart automation, and a relentless focus on the customer. We are a high-growth European scale-up , backed by €43M from world-class investors , on a mission to become a global leader in digital insurance for entrepreneurs and SMEs. Starting in the Netherlands, we’ve expanded into France and Germany, and we’re only accelerating from here. At our core, we’re a tech company . We build our own insurtech platform and rely heavily on data, automation, and AI to redesign the end-to-end insurance experience:  from underwriting to claims. Combined with a fully digital customer portal and strong UX, we’re turning insurance into something surprisingly simple, transparent, and fair. We’re led by seasoned entrepreneurs who’ve built and scaled companies before, and we bring that same ambition, urgency, and ownership mindset to everything we do. What you'll be doing: Insify is looking for an entrepreneurial and analytical Product Manager to drive the growth and evolution of our Property & Casualty (P&C) portfolio . This role focuses on the essential "bread and butter" products for SMEs: including General Liability, Professional Indemnity, and Property insurance. Unlike traditional PM roles, you won't just be managing features; you will be the "CEO" of your products. You will bridge the gap between complex insurance logic and a seamless digital user experience. You use your deep understanding of our customers and data native approach to translate technical policy wordings and insurance products into automated underwriting flows and digital-first customer journeys taking away the complexity for our customers. This is a perfect role for someone with a background in business operations, consulting, or insurance who wants to move into a high-growth tech environment and take tangible ownership of a product's performance. What you’ll be up to (some examples): Drive Product Strategy: Manage the roadmap for your products, ensuring they remain competitive, compliant, and easy to purchase online. Optimize the Funnel: Use data to identify friction points in the application process and work with Design and Tech to improve conversion rates. Scale New Markets: Support the launch of our digital proposition into new European markets, adapting local requirements into our scalable core platform. Stakeholder Management: Coordinate between Insurance, Tech, Marketing, and Customer Ops to ensure a unified product vision and smooth execution. Monitor Performance: Track loss ratios, retention, and customer feedback to iterate on the product and pricing strategy. This role is a strong fit if you are a "doer" who loves to solve puzzles. You can dive deep into the fine print of an insurance policy one hour and brainstorm a new UI flow with a developer the next. Specifically, you bring: 2–4 years of experience in a high-growth startup or strategy consulting (Insurance, Fintech, or E-commerce preferred). Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable with Excel/data tools and use metrics to back up your decisions. Product Curiosity: You don't need to be a coder, but you should be excited about how APIs, automated underwriting, and LLMs can transform insurance. Bias for Action: You prefer "shipping and iterating" over "analyzing and waiting." Communication: Excellent English skills (Dutch, German, or French is a major plus given our European footprint). Educational Background: A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field. Who this is not for: You prioritize a 40-hour work week : We operate in a high-intensity 'startup-plus' environment. This isn't a standard 9-to-5; driving global impact here requires a level of dedication and 'always-on' spirit that goes well beyond the typical 40-hour work week. You prefer your comfort zone : We operate at the edge of our capabilities; if you aren't comfortable with constant change and being challenged, you won’t thrive here. You prefer to stay high-level : While this is a strategic role, no task is too small. If you aren't willing to roll up your sleeves and get into the "weeds" of execution, this isn't the right fit. A steep learning curve feels daunting : We move fast and use cutting-edge AI; you need to be an aggressive self-learner who can master new domains in days, not months. What we offer: Competitive compensation - we want to attract and retain the best so we are offering a compensation package that aligns with that. In-office - come join us in our HQ in the center of Amsterdam. Grow in a growing company - there’s no better place to develop your talents and learn new skills. Help us show the world that insurance can be simple, transparent and trustworthy. Experienced entrepreneurs - work with experienced and dedicated entrepreneurs as part of an international team. Energetic environment - as a start-up, we’re different from your usual insurers. We scale rapidly and you can pick your own initiatives, helping us grow as we help more and more customers across Europe. Our culture (read this carefully) We’re not just building a company, we’re building a  category leader . That comes with ambition, responsibility, and pace. Our culture is defined by three things: High ownership People own problems end-to-end. If something is unclear or broken, we don’t wait - we step in and fix it. High pace Priorities shift, and decisions are made quickly. We value momentum and learning over perfection. High standards Outcomes matter more than optics. We care about results, quality, and follow-through. At the same time, you won’t be doing this alone . We believe great work happens through close collaboration . We work in-person, challenge each other’s ideas, and expect contributions from everywhere, regardless of title or tenure. The best ideas often come from unexpected places, and we create space for them to surface. This is a human-sized company . You’ll know the people you work with, you’ll be able to walk over to anyone to ask a question or test an idea, and you’ll be part of the day-to-day energy of building together:  from whiteboard discussions to shared lunches, dogs in the office, and moments to pause and reset. We hire smart, ambitious people who think like owners, value intellectual honesty, and are motivated by impact rather than comfort. If you enjoy challenge, responsibility, and building something meaningful with others, you’ll likely thrive here. If you’re looking for predictability, narrow scopes, or a guaranteed 9-to-5, this likely won’t be the right fit - and that’s okay. We’d rather be honest upfront. You will bridge the gap between complex insurance logic and a seamless digital user experience. You use your deep understanding of our customers and data native approach to translate technical policy wordings and insurance products into automated underwriting flows and digital-first customer journeys taking away the complexity for our customers.

This is a perfect role for someone with a background in business operations, consulting, or insurance who wants to move into a high-growth tech environment and take tangible ownership of a product's performance.


What you’ll be up to (some examples):
  • Drive Product Strategy: Manage the roadmap for your products, ensuring they remain competitive, compliant, and easy to purchase online.
  • Optimize the Funnel: Use data to identify friction points in the application process and work with Design and Tech to improve conversion rates.
  • Scale New Markets: Support the launch of our digital proposition into new European markets, adapting local requirements into our scalable core platform.
  • Stakeholder Management: Coordinate between Insurance, Tech, Marketing, and Customer Ops to ensure a unified product vision and smooth execution.
  • Monitor Performance: Track loss ratios, retention, and customer feedback to iterate on the product and pricing strategy.
    • This role is a strong fit if you are a "doer" who loves to solve puzzles. You can dive deep into the fine print of an insurance policy one hour and brainstorm a new UI flow with a developer the next.

    Specifically, you bring:
  • 2–4 years of experience in a high-growth startup or strategy consulting (Insurance, Fintech, or E-commerce preferred).
  • Analytical Rigor: You are comfortable with Excel/data tools and use metrics to back up your decisions.
  • Product Curiosity: You don't need to be a coder, but you should be excited about how APIs, automated underwriting, and LLMs can transform insurance.
  • Bias for Action: You prefer "shipping and iterating" over "analyzing and waiting."
  • Communication: Excellent English skills (Dutch, German, or French is a major plus given our European footprint).
  • Educational Background: A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.

    • Who this is not for:
  • You prioritize a 40-hour work week: We operate in a high-intensity 'startup-plus' environment. This isn't a standard 9-to-5; driving global impact here requires a level of dedication and 'always-on' spirit that goes well beyond the typical 40-hour work week.
  • You prefer your comfort zone: We operate at the edge of our capabilities; if you aren't comfortable with constant change and being challenged, you won’t thrive here.
  • You prefer to stay high-level: While this is a strategic role, no task is too small. If you aren't willing to roll up your sleeves and get into the "weeds" of execution, this isn't the right fit.
  • A steep learning curve feels daunting: We move fast and use cutting-edge AI; you need to be an aggressive self-learner who can master new domains in days, not months.

    • What we offer:
  • Competitive compensation - we want to attract and retain the best so we are offering a compensation package that aligns with that.
  • In-office - come join us in our HQ in the center of Amsterdam.
  • Grow in a growing company - there’s no better place to develop your talents and learn new skills. Help us show the world that insurance can be simple, transparent and trustworthy.
  • Experienced entrepreneurs - work with experienced and dedicated entrepreneurs as part of an international team.
  • Energetic environment - as a start-up, we’re different from your usual insurers. We scale rapidly and you can pick your own initiatives, helping us grow as we help more and more customers across Europe.

    • Our culture (read this carefully)

    We’re not just building a company, we’re building a category leader. That comes with ambition, responsibility, and pace.

    Our culture is defined by three things:

  • High ownership
    People own problems end-to-end. If something is unclear or broken, we don’t wait - we step in and fix it.
  • High pace
    Priorities shift, and decisions are made quickly. We value momentum and learning over perfection.
  • High standards
     Outcomes matter more than optics. We care about results, quality, and follow-through.

    • At the same time, you won’t be doing this alone.

    We believe great work happens through close collaboration. We work in-person, challenge each other’s ideas, and expect contributions from everywhere, regardless of title or tenure. The best ideas often come from unexpected places, and we create space for them to surface.

    This is a human-sized company. You’ll know the people you work with, you’ll be able to walk over to anyone to ask a question or test an idea, and you’ll be part of the day-to-day energy of building together:  from whiteboard discussions to shared lunches, dogs in the office, and moments to pause and reset.

    We hire smart, ambitious people who think like owners, value intellectual honesty, and are motivated by impact rather than comfort. If you enjoy challenge, responsibility, and building something meaningful with others, you’ll likely thrive here.

    If you’re looking for predictability, narrow scopes, or a guaranteed 9-to-5, this likely won’t be the right fit - and that’s okay. We’d rather be honest upfront.

About Insify

We are a start-up offering an end-to-end digital insurance platform focussing solely on European entrepreneurs and SMEs. We offer the best insurance to our customers thanks to our focus on user experience, our leading underwriting services, and our expertise in data. In short, we’ve made getting insured quick, transparent and simple.

We know how to innovate - our team of seasoned entrepreneurs has built a host of successful businesses in fintech and e-commerce (HelloFresh, Bloomon and SumUp to name a few!).We’ve already raised over €25M in funding from leading investors (Accel Ventures, Frontline Ventures, Visionaries Club, Nico Rosberg, etc.), who love what we do and see the potential for a revolution in digital insurance.

We started our journey in the Netherlands and with our mission to make business insurance fast, simple and fair we have been able to have a significant impact on that market. Since last year we also serve customers in France and Germany, and are rapidly expanding across the rest of Europe!

How we work

At Insify, we’re building more than just an insurance company—we’re creating a culture that’s bold, caring, and built to make a real difference. Everything we do is driven by our core values: grit, impact, care, and entrepreneurship.

We show up with passion and perseverance. We solve real problems and put people first—especially our customers. And we’re always looking for smarter, faster, more human ways to do things.

That’s also why we’ve chosen a pro-office approach. We believe that working together, face to face, sparks creativity, builds stronger teams, and helps us learn faster—especially for new joiners. From spontaneous brainstorms to shared lunches, being in the same space makes the magic happen.

Joining Insify means being part of a team that truly backs each other and the entrepreneurs we serve. If you’re ready to grow, innovate, and help reshape the insurance industry from the inside out—we’d love to meet you.

Insurance Team

We’re the team making insurance work for everyone and everything. At Insify, our Insurance crew is all about making sure the right coverages are available, affordable, and actually make sense for today’s entrepreneurs. We’re the bridge between customer needs and carrier capabilities—constantly exploring, negotiating, and building better insurance solutions.

From partnering with top carriers to developing our own products, we ensure our platform delivers complete, seamless coverage. Whether it’s a roofer in Rotterdam or a freelance designer in Berlin, we’re here to make sure no one’s left out. Our team includes insurance pros, actuaries, and product ops experts working hand-in-hand with product, legal, and compliance to reshape insurance from the inside out.

About the Role
 
This is your chance to work in a dynamic company where innovation and precision go hand in hand to disrupt the insurance industry. You'll be part of our Insurance team, as lead to ensure the scalability and sustainability of our portfolio optimizing both the bottom and top lines.
 
We are a data-driven company and we don’t lose time on tasks with little to no value therefore, on top of modeling the risk, price elasticity, customer lifetime value, and other key business drivers and trends, you will also be supporting the full End-to-end automation, set up of proper data flows, tooling and overall pricing platform solution.

What you will be doing
  • Pricing and Underwriting: Develop and refine pricing models, ensuring accurate underwriting and profitability while optimizing for growth.
  • Dig for and leverage internal and external data to develop predictive models that enhance pricing strategies and improve portfolio performance.
  • Evaluate and propose new ideas and collaborate with the team to develop and push in production innovative solutions (pricing elasticity and optimisation, behaviour and fraud scoring, exposure-based dynamic pricing…), 
  • Work with internal stakeholders to integrate actuarial insights into product, tech, regulatory compliance, and overall company strategy.
  • Follow market trends to recommend adjustments to pricing and products.
  • Lead relationships with risk carriers to drive impactful results.
  • Be part, with the pricing team, of the development of our End-to-end, fully automated, pricing and analytics platform leveraging on data and innovative in-house proprietary solutions to scale in a sustainable and efficient way and always stay ahead of competition.

    • What you'll need
  • Actuarial diploma (or equivalent).
  • 2–3+ years of experience in pricing and underwriting within Property & Casualty insurance or Life Insurance.
  • Strong data analytics skills and a passion for leveraging data to drive innovation.
  • A global mindset with exposure to developed insurance markets (e.g., UK, Germany, France) with a desire to disrupt a slow-moving industry.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a desire to build new things.
  • Strong interpersonal skills—smooth communication and collaboration are key!
  • Fluent in English

    • Bonus points if you:
  • Have experience with both risk and commercial price modeling. +2 points if you also have experience with survival models. 
  • Master in Python and/or R and/or SQL
    • What we offer

    Competitive compensation - we want to attract and retain the best so we are offering a compensation package that aligns with that.
    Pension plan - participation to Insify’s Pension Plan, with 6% employer contribution.
    Travel reimbursement - we help travelers with their commute.
    Hybrid - Possibility to work from home two times a week.
    25 holidays days per year - (+ extra day on Christmas eve if it’s a weekday!)
    Subscription to Alleo - 50 EUR (net) monthly (cumulable) budget to spend on what you like - anything from gym memberships to UberEats!
    Company events - Monthly team drinks, quarterly offsites, lunch and learns, parties, merch and FUN!
    Company Macbook - get the best laptop to get your job done in no time!
    Quickly develop your career - there’s no better place to develop. We are growing and you can grow with us! Inhouse leadership programs and coaching
    High degree of autonomy - it’s time to ACTUALLY make an impact!

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Backend Platform (PHP and Python)
description: WHO WE ARE 🌍 Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does. Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work. We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟 Want to own how the backend works for everyone, not just one corner of it? We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who works across PHP and Python and wants a say in the bigger picture. You’ll lead company-level projects like our Auth Service: one authorization layer for PHP and Python, so Python products can handle their traffic directly instead of going through PHP. When things are unclear, you’ll research first, weigh the trade-offs and write them down. Then you’ll ship in small, safe steps. You’ll also decide where code should live based on what’s best for the system, not on which language you know best. Product teams will come to you for advice, reviews, and a way through when they're stuck. The team is still taking shape, so you'll also help define ownership, standards, and how we work. If that mix of deep technical work and influence across teams sounds like you, keep reading. YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋 Meet the Backend Platform team: We're a small team of engineers from core PHP, Infra, and AI backgrounds. We lead technical initiatives across the whole backend and own its health. Product teams build and run their own components, and we give them the tools, standards, and expertise to do it well. Each of us leads our own project, from planning to agreeing with other teams to production. We work in weekly cycles and write our decisions down. Right now we're bringing PHP and Python platform work together into one common backend platform. WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀 Lead company-level technical projects end to end, from design and planning to rollout and support, such as completing our Auth Service development and shaping authorization as a separate layer for PHP and Python. Shape the shared PHP and Python platform, and decide where each module should live based on the needs of the whole system. Build the foundations that let new Python products launch and scale without being wired through PHP each time. Define clear ownership of technical components across the backend, including who owns monitoring and knowledge for each. Improve how we spot and handle problems: bug and incident management, less noise in alerts and error tracking, and Grafana Cloud dashboards for how services interact. Find root causes across PHP and Python services using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing. Make performance part of everyday work, not something we fix after incidents: clear performance metrics, tools that show where things slow down, and analysis of unusual user behavior that causes degradation. Make architecture decisions with high load in mind, working with databases, servers, proxies, and DNS alongside the Infra team. Work with the Security team to fix vulnerabilities, build in security practices, and keep libraries and dependencies up to date. Improve developer experience: dev environment, CI/CD, routine automation, one documentation approach for PHP and Python, and tools for AI coding assistants. Turn product teams' requests into solutions: find what really hurts, propose the best fix, and support them with architecture advice and reviews in shared components. TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥 You'll need: Production backend experience in PHP or Python, and the ability to read and work with the other. You'll write production code in both. Experience with high-load production systems and improving their performance. Experience designing multi-component systems with clear boundaries, planning for failures, rollout, and rollback, with security in mind. Experience comparing technical options, naming the trade-offs, and explaining your choice in writing (ADRs, Design Docs). Hands-on observability experience: metrics, dashboards, alerts, logs, and distributed tracing, and using them to find root causes. Experience leading a project that spans several teams: breaking it into small, testable steps, getting other teams on board, and taking it to production. A track record of improving engineering quality beyond your own tasks, for example setting up error monitoring, or a new process when things kept breaking. Enough infrastructure knowledge (databases, servers, proxies, DNS) to work well with Infra and see how your changes affect them. Clear communication: you explain your point of view, find the real problem behind a request, and flag risks early. Experience leading work independently while supporting your team: taking feedback, helping colleagues grow, and changing your mind when the arguments are good. It would be great if you have: Experience on a Platform or Core team. Strong production experience in both PHP and Python. Experience with authentication and authorization systems (for example, JWT or Ory Oathkeeper). Experience defining SLOs and building symptom-based alerts. Experience running incidents and blameless post-mortems. Experience with Grafana Cloud, Rollbar, or similar tools. Experience building developer tooling, CI/CD, or tools for AI coding assistants. Experience mentoring engineers or leading knowledge sharing across teams. WHAT WE OFFER 🤗 We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort: 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family. 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family. 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow. 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office. 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota. 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks. 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events. 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster. Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. You’ll lead company-level projects like our Auth Service: one authorization layer for PHP and Python, so Python products can handle their traffic directly instead of going through PHP. When things are unclear, you’ll research first, weigh the trade-offs and write them down. Then you’ll ship in small, safe steps. You’ll also decide where code should live based on what’s best for the system, not on which language you know best.

Product teams will come to you for advice, reviews, and a way through when they're stuck. The team is still taking shape, so you'll also help define ownership, standards, and how we work. If that mix of deep technical work and influence across teams sounds like you, keep reading.

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

We're a small team of engineers from core PHP, Infra, and AI backgrounds. We lead technical initiatives across the whole backend and own its health. Product teams build and run their own components, and we give them the tools, standards, and expertise to do it well. Each of us leads our own project, from planning to agreeing with other teams to production. We work in weekly cycles and write our decisions down. Right now we're bringing PHP and Python platform work together into one common backend platform.

  • Build the foundations that let new Python products launch and scale without being wired through PHP each time.

  • Find root causes across PHP and Python services using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.

  • Make performance part of everyday work, not something we fix after incidents: clear performance metrics, tools that show where things slow down, and analysis of unusual user behavior that causes degradation.

  • Make architecture decisions with high load in mind, working with databases, servers, proxies, and DNS alongside the Infra team.

  • Work with the Security team to fix vulnerabilities, build in security practices, and keep libraries and dependencies up to date.

  • Improve developer experience: dev environment, CI/CD, routine automation, one documentation approach for PHP and Python, and tools for AI coding assistants.

System Engineer – Machine Control
Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Senior, 8+ years of relevant experience

About us
AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase, small, and growing.

The role
You own how our tool is controlled and operated. The machine combines lasers, high-speed cameras, a nanometer-precision wafer stage and GPU-based image reconstruction. Every measurement depends on these parts working together in tight synchronization. You are the system engineer for that layer: the control architecture, the timing, the machine software, and the data path from sensor to result. You work side by side with our system engineer for the metrology hardware and with our algorithms team, and together you lead the system.

You will:

  • Own the system control architecture: machine software, control hardware, timing and synchronization, and the data path from acquisition to reconstruction

  • Translate system performance and throughput goals into requirements for control, software and compute, and keep them traceable

  • Own the timing, throughput and data budgets, and decide where time is won or lost in a measurement

  • Define and guard the interfaces between control software, hardware and algorithms, including the hardware abstraction layer

  • Define how the machine is operated: machine states, sequencing, recipes, error handling, logging and monitoring

  • Steer the software and embedded engineers on the control side: set priorities, run design reviews and resolve trade-offs

  • Set up integration and verification of the control layer, with a test strategy that keeps it reliable as the hardware changes between builds

  • Carry the machine software from lab prototype toward a production tool that runs unattended in a fab

Your profile

  • 8+ years in high-tech equipment, including several years as a system engineer, software architect or control architect for a complex machine

  • Experience with machine control in semiconductor, lithography, metrology or scientific instruments

  • Hands-on understanding of real-time and deterministic systems: hardware triggering, FPGA-based synchronization, motion control and high-rate data acquisition

  • Strong in equipment software architecture: layered designs, hardware abstraction, state machines and concurrency

  • Comfortable reading code and reviewing designs in Python and C/C++. You won’t write most of the code, but you can.

  • Strong in requirements, budgets and interface management across hardware and software

  • This is not a role in a large organization with fixed processes: you help decide how we work. You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where roles are fluid, and you are as likely to be at the lab bench debugging a trigger as in a design review.

  • A clear communicator with engineers, management and partners

  • Full professional proficiency in English

Bonus:

  • Taking machine software from prototype to production, including SEMI standards for equipment communication and automation (such as SECS/GEM) and machine safety

  • Integration with wafer handling and factory automation

  • High-throughput data pipelines or GPU computing

  • Experience with optical or imaging systems: cameras, lasers, image data

  • Model-based systems engineering or modern requirements tools

We care more about systems thinking and ownership than about a perfect match. If your title was software architect, control architect or lead engineer, but you have owned how a complex machine runs, apply anyway.

What we offer

  • Shared technical leadership of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet

  • Small team, short feedback loops, real impact on the product

  • Competitive salary for the Dutch market

title: Mobile Developer
description: At Luscii, we develop several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together, we build technology that makes healthcare more accessible, giving patients and healthcare professionals more space to focus on care. As a Mobile Developer , you will contribute to this mission by developing and improving the applications that connect people, devices and healthcare. Our digital health solutions enable healthcare professionals to monitor patients remotely, helping people receive the right care in the right place. You will work across our mobile applications, creating reliable, intuitive and high-performing experiences for patients and healthcare professionals alike. Beyond developing and improving our apps, you will help shape our technical direction, explore new technologies and share your expertise with colleagues. You will have the autonomy to take ownership, make technical decisions and contribute beyond your immediate responsibilities, supported by Luscii's Holacratic way of working. Your role As a Mobile Developer at Luscii, you will take ownership of the development, optimisation and maintenance of our mobile applications across iOS and Android. You bring ideas to life, make well-considered technical decisions and help ensure our applications remain performant, stable, scalable and easy to maintain. You will work closely with colleagues across development, QA and support, combining hands-on engineering with technical ownership. Whether you are building a new feature, exploring a technology through a proof of concept or resolving a production issue, you will help us continuously improve the quality and usability of our digital health solutions. What you will be doing: Develop, maintain and optimise mobile applications using native technologies such as Kotlin and Swift, with a focus on performance, stability and user experience. Contribute to mobile architecture, technical design and modular codebases, applying clean architecture, object-oriented design principles and patterns such as MVVM and MVI. Build intuitive user interfaces using technologies such as Jetpack Compose and SwiftUI, following platform-specific design guidelines. Develop and maintain features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices, as well as web services, cloud platforms and APIs. Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore new technologies, validate technical approaches and identify opportunities for improvement. Investigate and resolve production issues through debugging and performance analysis, covering areas such as memory management, multithreading and networking. Contribute to code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD processes, sharing technical knowledge and helping colleagues make sound implementation decisions. Why Luscii? Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Most important benefits Salary : € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii). Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii . Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. The ideal candidate… … probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others. You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust. You have at least five years of experience in mobile development, with a strong background in native Android and/or iOS development. You have extensive experience with Kotlin and/or Swift. You have a relevant bachelor's degree, for example in Computer Science or Computer Engineering and you are familiar with working in an Agile environment. You have a solid understanding of mobile architecture and software design principles, including clean architecture, object-oriented design, MVVM and/or MVI. You know how to build and maintain modular applications. You have experience with mobile development frameworks and tools such as Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI, Kotlin Coroutines, Flow and Kotlin Multiplatform. You are also familiar with unit testing and/or UI testing, CI/CD pipelines and platform-specific design guidelines. You understand what it takes to build reliable, high-performing mobile applications, including memory management, multithreading, networking, debugging and optimisation. You have experience integrating web services, cloud technologies, APIs and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices. You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities; English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language. Interested? Apply now! Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via What does the recruitment process look like? We organise three interviews for each vacancy.
